66494.recognize_zh: 單顆嗜中性球被一整圈血小板緊密包圍，形成明顯的血小板玫瑰花環 (platelet rosette)，其餘背景幾乎沒有游離血小板，是血小板衛星現象 (platelet satellitism) 的典型畫面。
features: Single mature neutrophil completely surrounded by a dense corona of adherent platelets
Platelets are normal in size and granularity
Neutrophil shows segmented nucleus and fine granular cytoplasm without toxic change
Scarce free platelets in the surrounding field
Normochromic red cells in a moderately thick area
66494.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil surrounded by a complete ring of normal-sized platelets adherent to its surface. Free-lying platelets are rare in the remainder of the field. Red cells are normochromic without notable poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro artifact that sequesters platelets and yields a spuriously low automated platelet count.

ddx.vs: Clumps are free aggregates of platelets not centered on a leukocyte.
Phagocytosis shows platelets within cytoplasmic vacuoles inside the neutrophil rather than attached to its outer surface.
True thrombocytopenia lacks rosettes, and the low count persists in citrate or heparin samples.

66430.recognize_zh: 高倍網狀纖維染色可見大量粗黑纖維彼此交錯並聚成粗束，整個視野幾乎沒有造血細胞，只剩少數小血管空隙，屬於最高等級 MF-3 的骨髓纖維化。
features: Dense, diffuse meshwork of coarse black reticulin fibers with extensive intersections throughout the field
Thick parallel fiber bundles streaming across the right half of the image
Few small vascular or sinusoidal lumens embedded in the fibrotic stroma
Hematopoietic precursors essentially absent; no fat cells retained
Collagen deposition cannot be confirmed without a trichrome stain
66430.describe_en: High-power view of a reticulin-stained bone marrow trephine shows a diffuse and dense increase in coarse reticulin fibers with extensive intersections and thick bundles. Small vessels are entrapped within the fibrous stroma, and residual hematopoietic cells and adipocytes are virtually absent. Findings correspond to WHO reticulin grade MF-3, consistent with advanced (overt fibrotic) myelofibrosis; trichrome staining would assess associated collagen.

ddx.vs: MF-1 shows a loose network of thin fibers with many intersections, especially perivascularly, rather than coarse bundles replacing the marrow.

ddx.dx: Fibrosis due to lymphoma or carcinoma infiltration
ddx.vs: Infiltrative neoplasms leave identifiable tumor cells in the fibrotic stroma that are revealed on H&E and immunostains.
Therapy-related fibrosis is diagnosed clinically and usually lacks the atypical megakaryocytic clusters and driver mutations of an MPN.

66366.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的纖維化區域內可見淡色、呈扇形或放射狀排列的針狀結晶聚集，周圍有梭形細胞與組織球反應包圍；在骨髓切片中看到這種結晶加異物反應，應想到草酸鹽沉積（hyperoxalosis）。
features: Pale, refractile, needle-shaped crystals arranged in fan-like/radiating aggregates within a peritrabecular fibrous nodule
Crystal aggregates surrounded by spindle cells and histiocytes consistent with a foreign-body-type reaction
Adjacent broad lamellar bone trabecula with irregular, scalloped surfaces suggesting active remodeling
Peritrabecular fibrosis displacing hematopoietic marrow
Separate amorphous basophilic deposit in the upper right field, likely additional crystal/mineral material
Residual cellular marrow with scattered adipocytes at the periphery of the core
66366.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow trephine shows a broad bony trabecula with irregular, scalloped margins. Adjacent to the trabecula there is a fibrous nodule containing aggregates of pale, needle-shaped crystals in radiating sheaves, surrounded by spindle cells and histiocytes in keeping with a foreign-body reaction. Peritrabecular fibrosis is present, and an additional amorphous basophilic deposit is seen in the upper right field; the remaining marrow is cellular with scattered fat. Polarized-light examination is not available in this image. Findings are consistent with marrow and bone involvement by oxalate crystal deposition (hyperoxalosis).

ddx.vs: Urate deposits are usually amorphous, feathery material dissolved out of formalin-fixed tissue with a palisading histiocytic rim and are negatively birefringent needles, whereas calcium oxalate crystals persist in routine sections as pale yellow rhomboid/rosette crystals that are strongly birefringent.
Shows tunneling resorption and peritrabecular fibrosis similar to this case but lacks crystal aggregates with a foreign-body giant cell reaction.
Histiocytes contain intracytoplasmic eosinophilic rod-like immunoglobulin crystals associated with a plasma cell neoplasm rather than extracellular radiating crystal sheaves in fibrous stroma.

ddx.dx: Foreign-material granuloma (e.g., prior biopsy site debris)
ddx.vs: Exogenous material is typically localized to a prior procedure track and lacks the multifocal rosette-shaped birefringent crystals of systemic oxalosis.

65918.recognize_zh: 中央幾顆異常前骨髓細胞的細胞質裡有成束交錯、細針狀的 Auer 小體（像一捆柴），核形不規則、部分呈雙葉狀；這就是 faggot cell，看到它應立即想到急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with irregular, partly bilobed/folded nuclei
Multiple bundles of crisscrossing needle-like Auer rods filling the cytoplasm (faggot cells)
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent at this focus
Abundant granular cytoplasm with irregular cell borders
Background red cells with scattered platelets; occasional crenated red cell (smear artifact)
65918.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with irregular, partly bilobed nuclei and abundant cytoplasm. Several cells contain numerous bundles of crisscrossing needle-like Auer rods (faggot cells). The background red cells show no specific abnormality apart from minor drying artifact. Findings are highly suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent coagulation studies and confirmation of PML::RARA are warranted.

ddx.vs: Blasts in AML with t(8;21) usually carry a single long slender Auer rod rather than multiple bundled rods, and nuclei are not bilobed.
The variant shows bilobed nuclei with few visible granules and rare faggot cells, whereas this field shows abundant bundled Auer rods.

ddx.dx: Reactive promyelocytes (left shift or G-CSF effect)
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes have regular round nuclei with a perinuclear hof and never contain Auer rods.

65790.recognize_zh: 這是 FISH 報告表格，不是形態學影像：7 號染色體三色探針顯示著絲點 2 個、7q22 與 7q36 各 3 個訊號（196/200 細胞），代表 7q 長臂多一套而非缺失，評為等臂染色體 7q（i(7q)）；另見 8 號三體（trisomy 8）佔 98%，兩者合併是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的典型遺傳變化。
features: Interphase FISH on directly harvested peripheral blood, 200 nuclei scored per probe
7q22/7q36/CEP7 triple-color probe: nuc ish(D7Z1x2, CUTL1x3, D7S2419x3)[196/200], i.e. two centromeres with three copies of 7q
Reported as negative for del(7q); signal gain of 7q with normal centromere count interpreted as isochromosome 7q in 98% of cells
CEP8 probe: nuc ish(D8Z1x3)[196/200], positive for trisomy 8 in 98% of cells
Interphase FISH cannot directly visualize the isochromosome; metaphase karyotype or metaphase FISH confirms the structure
65790.describe_en: This figure is an interphase FISH report rather than a morphologic image. Using a 7q22/7q36/CEP7 triple-color probe, 196 of 200 nuclei show two chromosome 7 centromere signals with three signals each at 7q22 (CUTL1) and 7q36 (D7S2419), indicating relative gain of 7q without deletion; the pattern is interpreted as isochromosome 7q. The CEP8 probe shows three signals in 196 of 200 nuclei, indicating trisomy 8. Isochromosome 7q with trisomy 8 in a high proportion of cells is characteristic of, and supports the diagnosis of, hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Monosomy 7 or del(7q) in myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Myeloid -7/del(7q) shows loss of 7q signals (one copy), whereas this pattern shows a gain of 7q with preserved centromeres.
Trisomy 7 would show three centromere (D7Z1) signals together with three 7q signals rather than two centromeres.
T-LGL leukemia can be gamma-delta and involve spleen but lacks i(7q), is usually CD57 positive and cytotoxic granular rather than blastoid.

65214.recognize_zh: 血片中一條細長、彎曲蜿蜒的線狀蟲體，長度相當於數十顆紅血球，體內有一列深紫色的體核，尾端逐漸變細，即血液中的微絲蟲（microfilaria）；鞘膜在此圖中不明顯，種別需看鞘與尾端核分布。
features: Very long, slender, thread-like larva spanning dozens of red cell diameters, with graceful serpentine curves
Body filled with a column of densely packed dark purple somatic nuclei
Tapering tail end; a nucleus-free tail tip is suggested but not clearly resolvable
Sheath not clearly distinguishable from the body at this magnification
Background of red cells with numerous neutrophils and scattered eosinophils
65214.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single, very long and slender nematode larva with sinuous curves, containing a dense column of dark-staining somatic nuclei and tapering toward the tail. The sheath and the precise distribution of nuclei at the tail tip cannot be confidently assessed at this magnification. The background contains red cells, neutrophils and scattered eosinophils. Findings are consistent with a microfilaria; the described features favor Wuchereria bancrofti, but species identification rests on the presence of a sheath, the cephalic space and the nucleus-free tail, ideally confirmed on Giemsa-stained thick films or by antigen testing.

ddx.vs: Brugia microfilariae are sheathed with a sheath staining pink on Giemsa and have two distinct separate terminal nuclei at the tail tip.
Loa loa microfilariae are sheathed but have nuclei extending continuously to the tip of the tail and show diurnal periodicity.
Mansonella perstans microfilariae are small, unsheathed, and have nuclei extending to a bluntly rounded tail tip.
Artifactual fibers lack internal nuclei and the organized tapering head and tail of a larva.

65726.recognize_zh: 寬厚的骨小樑表面可見多核蝕骨細胞（箭頭）貼附在吸收凹陷（Howship lacunae）內，形成蝕骨細胞沿骨緣排列；髓腔中有一小島造血細胞及周圍紡錘狀基質，與骨質硬化病的骨髓變化相符。
features: Thickened, irregular bony trabeculae with scalloped surfaces
Multinucleated osteoclasts with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm sitting in resorption bays along the bone surface (arrows)
Osteoclastic rimming of trabeculae
Intertrabecular island of mixed hematopoietic cells surrounded by loose spindle-cell stroma
Small lymphoid-appearing cell clusters adjacent to trabeculae
65726.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate magnification shows thickened, irregular trabeculae with scalloped surfaces. Multiple multinucleated osteoclasts are present in Howship lacunae along trabecular surfaces, producing osteoclastic rimming. The intertrabecular space contains a cellular island of mixed hematopoietic elements surrounded by loose fibrous stroma. In conjunction with the osteosclerosis and radiographic findings, these features are consistent with osteopetrosis, in which osteoclasts may be numerous but functionally defective.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have a single hyperlobated nucleus and lie within the marrow cavity, whereas osteoclasts are truly multinucleated and sit in resorption bays on bone.
Hyperparathyroidism shows tunneling resorption into trabeculae with marrow fibrosis and elevated PTH, rather than dense sclerotic bone in an infant.
Pagetic osteoclasts are huge with dozens of nuclei and accompany mosaic cement lines in older adults.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular aggregates of spindled CD117+/tryptase+ mast cells, not multinucleated osteoclasts.

65534.recognize_zh: 紅色箭頭指出大型細胞，核大且染色質推向核膜邊緣，中央有類似核仁、玻璃狀的核內包涵體，並有核中央透明化；這就是 Parvovirus B19 感染的巨大前紅血球母細胞，而周圍幾乎看不到成熟中的紅系細胞。
features: Scattered giant proerythroblasts (red arrows) markedly larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells
Large nuclei with central clearing and chromatin margination
Glassy, nucleolus-like intranuclear viral inclusions
Paucity of maturing erythroid precursors in a cellular marrow
Scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages with golden-brown pigment
65534.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a cellular marrow with scattered giant proerythroblasts, highlighted by arrows. These cells have large nuclei with marginated chromatin, central nuclear clearing, and glassy nucleolus-like intranuclear inclusions. Maturing erythroid precursors are sparse, and scattered hemosiderin-laden macrophages are present. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia; confirmation with parvovirus immunostain, in situ hybridization, or PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows many erythroid precursors with open sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, not isolated giant proerythroblasts with viral inclusions and erythroid depletion.
Acute erythroid leukemia has sheets of atypical proerythroblasts with p53 overexpression rather than scattered proerythroblasts in an erythroid-poor marrow.
Megakaryocytes have lobated nuclei and CD61 expression, and Hodgkin cells have CD30/CD15 expression and lack intranuclear viral inclusions.
CMV causes enlarged endothelial or stromal cells with owl-eye inclusions and cytoplasmic inclusions, confirmed by CMV immunostain rather than parvovirus markers.

65342.recognize_zh: 抹片中大量細胞核呈雙葉、摺疊或腎形（butterfly／bilobed nucleus），染色質細緻，細胞質淡藍且幾乎沒有顆粒，成片出現，這是低顆粒型 APL（hypogranular／microgranular variant）的典型形態。
features: Sheets of medium to large cells with bilobed, folded, reniform or 'butterfly' nuclei
Fine, delicate chromatin with nuclear grooves and overlapping lobes
Moderate amounts of pale gray-blue cytoplasm with sparse or no visible granules
No Auer rods clearly visible in this field
High cell density with many smudged/crushed cells; normal neutrophils not evident
65342.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a markedly increased population of medium to large cells with bilobed, folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale cytoplasm that is largely devoid of visible granules. Auer rods are not clearly identified in this field, and mature neutrophils are sparse. The nuclear configuration with hypogranular cytoplasm and high white cell count is characteristic of the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia, which can be mistaken for monocytic leukemia. Findings are consistent with hypogranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; strong MPO positivity and PML::RARA confirmation are expected, and coagulopathy should be evaluated urgently.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes have folded nuclei too, but are MPO weak/negative, NSE strongly positive and HLA-DR/CD14/CD64 positive, whereas hypogranular APL is strongly MPO-positive and HLA-DR negative.
Cup-like blasts can resemble folded nuclei and are CD34/HLA-DR negative, but lack PML::RARA and usually show less intense MPO staining.

ddx.dx: Sézary cells or T-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Cerebriform nuclei have condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and are MPO negative with T-cell markers.

65278.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆雙核的晚期紅血球母細胞（兩個大小相近、染色質濃縮的圓核共用一片灰粉色細胞質），旁邊多顆紅系前驅細胞染色質顆粒粗細不一，提示紅系發育不良（erythroid dysplasia）。
features: Binucleate late erythroblast with two round, condensed, equal-sized nuclei in grey-pink cytoplasm (center)
Several erythroid precursors with coarsely granular chromatin and variably basophilic cytoplasm, some with irregular nuclear outlines
A basophilic erythroblast with deeply blue cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs adjacent to the binucleate cell
Small pyknotic orthochromatic erythroblasts scattered in the field
Hypocellular, spread-out aspirate area with background mature red cells; Romanowsky-type staining despite the H&E label
65278.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a spread-out field containing scattered erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation. A binucleate late erythroblast with two equal, condensed nuclei is present, and several neighboring erythroblasts show irregular nuclear contours and uneven chromatin; discrete nuclear budding is not clearly resolved at this magnification. The staining pattern is Romanowsky-type rather than H&E. In the context of a complex abnormal karyotype including 17p deletion, the findings are consistent with erythroid dysplasia of a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroblasts show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands, and resolve with vitamin replacement, whereas MDS shows a clonal karyotype and persists.
CDA II shows a high proportion of binucleate late erythroblasts in a young patient without cytogenetic abnormalities or dysplasia in other lineages.

ddx.dx: Therapy- or toxin-related dyserythropoiesis (e.g., alcohol, chemotherapy, arsenic)
ddx.vs: Reactive dyserythropoiesis is transient with a relevant exposure and lacks a clonal karyotype such as the complex 17p-deleted karyotype here.

65086.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見兩個萎縮、淡染的生發中心並排包在同一個擴大的外套區（mantle zone）裡，周圍小淋巴球呈同心圓「洋蔥皮」排列，生發中心內有玻璃樣變的小血管；一個濾泡內含兩個以上生發中心（twinning）是單中心性 Castleman 病（透明血管型）的特徵之一。
features: Two small, regressed, pale germinal centers sitting side by side within a single shared follicle (twinning)
Markedly expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric onion-skin layers
Germinal centers depleted of lymphocytes, composed of eosinophilic stroma, follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells
Small hyalinized or thick-walled vessels within and around the germinal centers
Interfollicular areas with increased small vessels containing RBCs
65086.describe_en: Lymph node section at low power shows a lymphoid follicle containing two small, atrophic germinal centers within a single, markedly expanded mantle zone. The mantle lymphocytes are small and mature and are arranged in concentric onion-skin rings. The germinal centers are lymphocyte-depleted, composed predominantly of follicular dendritic cells and endothelial cells with small hyalinized vessels, and interfollicular vascularity is increased. No sheets of atypical cells are seen. Findings are consistent with unicentric Castleman disease, hyaline-vascular type.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have large active germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and polarized thin mantles rather than regressed germinal centers with onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: HHV8-associated or idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease
ddx.vs: Multicentric disease usually shows sheets of interfollicular plasma cells, systemic symptoms and multiple nodal stations, and HHV8 (LANA-1) staining distinguishes the HHV8-associated form.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL expands the mantle with monotonous slightly irregular cells that are cyclin D1+/CD5+, whereas Castleman mantle cells are polyclonal and cyclin D1-negative.

ddx.dx: Follicular dendritic cell sarcoma arising in Castleman disease
ddx.vs: FDC sarcoma forms sheets or fascicles of atypical spindle to ovoid CD21/CD23+ cells effacing the node, not isolated regressed germinal centers.

65150.recognize_zh: 腹水抹片中一個大型圓形細胞團，中央為淡染、含細點狀物質的巨大空泡，周邊有三個深染、被壓扁的新月形細胞核，像印戒一樣環繞，屬於轉移性癌伴印戒細胞分化的典型線索。
features: Large rounded cell cluster with a central, voluminous pale vacuole containing faint granular/mucoid material
Three dense crescent- to oval-shaped hyperchromatic nuclei displaced to the periphery
Thin rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm encircling the vacuole
Size markedly larger than the adjacent small cell/red cell ghost
Paucicellular clean background; soft focus limits chromatin and nucleolar detail
65150.describe_en: Ascitic fluid smear shows a large, rounded cluster with a central voluminous pale vacuole containing faint mucoid material, around which three hyperchromatic, crescentic nuclei are compressed at the periphery within a thin rim of basophilic cytoplasm. The configuration recapitulates signet-ring morphology, either as a multinucleated cell or as a tight cluster of cells sharing a mucin vacuole. The background is paucicellular, and nuclear detail is limited by focus. Findings are suggestive of metastatic carcinoma with signet-ring cell differentiation; confirmation by cell block with mucin stains and epithelial immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.dx: Reactive mesothelial cells with degenerative vacuolation
ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells show central nuclei, peripheral lacy skirt and multiple small vacuoles, and are calretinin/WT1-positive and mucin-negative.
Macrophages have single bland reniform nuclei and multiple small foamy vacuoles, CD68-positive, rather than crescentic nuclei compressed by one large vacuole.
Mesothelioma forms three-dimensional morules with cell windows and is calretinin/WT1/D2-40-positive and mucin-negative, unlike a signet-ring adenocarcinoma.

64958.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖而非形態影像：多條染色體呈三套（如 5、7、9、15、19）且 21 號有四條，總數約 57–59 條，屬高雙倍體（hyperdiploid）；1、8、10、16 號旁附有標示結構異常的示意圖，與骨髓瘤常見的奇數染色體三體及 1 號染色體異常相符。
features: G-banded karyogram, not a morphologic image; resolution limits band-level assessment
Hyperdiploid chromosome count (approximately 57-59 on visual count)
Trisomies of several odd-numbered chromosomes (5, 7, 9, 15, 19) and four copies of chromosome 21, typical of hyperdiploid myeloma
Extra copies of additional chromosomes including 2, 6, 12, 16 and 17; single chromosome 22
Ideograms flag structurally abnormal homologs of chromosomes 1, 8, 10 and 16; the marker slot is empty
64958.describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram from a plasma cell myeloma bone marrow sample rather than a morphologic image. Visual count shows a hyperdiploid clone of roughly 57-59 chromosomes with trisomies of odd-numbered chromosomes (including 5, 7, 9, 15 and 19), tetrasomy 21, additional gains of chromosomes such as 2, 6, 12 and 17, and structural abnormalities highlighted by ideograms on chromosomes 1, 8, 10 and 16. The chromosome 1 rearrangement corresponds to the reported 1q gain with 1p deletion. The exact karyotype cannot be verified at this resolution, but the pattern is consistent with a complex hyperdiploid myeloma karyotype with high-risk chromosome 1 abnormalities, confirmed by FISH.

ddx.vs: Non-hyperdiploid myeloma typically shows a near-diploid or hypodiploid karyotype with IGH translocations such as t(4;14), t(11;14) or t(14;16), which FISH did not detect in this case.

High hyperdiploid B-ALL shows gains of chromosomes X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18 and 21 in children, whereas myeloma hyperdiploidy favors odd chromosomes 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 15, 19 and 21 in a plasma cell neoplasm.

64638.recognize_zh: 中央大細胞有兩個偏位的核，深藍色細胞質內擠滿大小不一、淡藍色圓形空泡狀的 Russell bodies，呈葡萄串樣，即雙核 Mott cell；周圍則是一群核質比高、染色質細緻的單調母細胞。
features: Large binucleate plasma cell with two small eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm filled with multiple round, pale blue, uniform globular inclusions (Russell bodies), grape-like appearance
Surrounding monotonous blasts: medium-to-large, high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, some with small nucleoli and a thin rim of agranular cytoplasm
No Auer rods seen in the blasts in this field
Background of red cells and scattered platelets in a bone marrow aspirate
64638.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large binucleate plasma cell whose deeply basophilic cytoplasm is distended by numerous round, pale globular inclusions, imparting a grape-cluster appearance consistent with Russell bodies. The two nuclei are small and eccentric with condensed chromatin. The surrounding cells are a monotonous population of blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant agranular cytoplasm. Findings are consistent with a binucleate Mott cell, a nonspecific reactive plasma cell change, in a marrow involved by acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with Mott cell morphology
ddx.vs: Mott cells are nonspecific; myeloma requires increased clonal plasma cells with light-chain restriction and atypia, rather than an isolated Mott cell in a blast-predominant marrow.

Macrophage vacuoles are clear or contain ingested cells/debris with a reniform nucleus and gray cytoplasm, whereas these inclusions are uniform pale-blue immunoglobulin globules in basophilic plasma cell cytoplasm.
Gaucher cells have wrinkled 'tissue paper' cytoplasm without discrete round globules and are much larger with a small central nucleus.
Blast vacuoles are small, empty and punched-out in high N:C cells with fine chromatin, rather than large globules in a mature plasma cell with clumped chromatin.

64510.recognize_zh: A–F 的成熟小淋巴球細胞質內有許多大小一致、邊界清楚的圓形空泡，常排成一圈圍繞核；G 為對照的嗜中性球與單核球空泡。成熟淋巴球出現明顯空泡應懷疑溶小體儲積症。
features: Panels A–F: small to medium mature lymphocytes with round to slightly indented nuclei and condensed chromatin
Multiple discrete, sharply punched-out, clear round cytoplasmic vacuoles in lymphocytes
Vacuoles often arranged around the nucleus in a rim of pale blue cytoplasm
No azurophilic granules or inclusions within the vacuoles
Panel G: comparison neutrophil and monocyte with cytoplasmic vacuolation
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
64510.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows mature lymphocytes (panels A–F) containing numerous discrete, sharply defined clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, often forming a rim around the nucleus. Lymphocyte nuclei are otherwise mature with condensed chromatin, and no abnormal granules are identified. Panel G shows vacuolation in a neutrophil and monocyte for comparison, a nonspecific finding in phagocytic cells. Vacuolated mature lymphocytes are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder, which in this patient was confirmed as galactosialidosis (CTSA mutation).

ddx.vs: MPS characteristically shows Alder-Reilly granules and Gasser cells with elevated urine glycosaminoglycans, which were normal here.

ddx.dx: Other storage disorders with vacuolated lymphocytes (Pompe, Wolman, Niemann-Pick, juvenile Batten, sialidosis)
ddx.vs: These share lymphocyte vacuolation, so separation depends on enzyme assays and genetic testing rather than morphology.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and nucleoli, rather than mature small lymphocytes with clear vacuoles.
Storage artifact vacuolates neutrophils and monocytes in delayed samples and rarely produces uniform discrete vacuoles in mature lymphocytes.

64446.recognize_zh: 十個小視野都是大型反應性淋巴球（Downey 細胞）：細胞質豐富、淡藍到深藍，邊緣呈裙擺狀包繞並被相鄰紅血球壓出凹痕，越靠近邊緣藍色越深；細胞核形態多樣、染色質較疏鬆，符合 EBV 感染性單核球增多症。
features: Large lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm and low to moderate N:C ratio
Cytoplasm pale grey-blue centrally with deeper basophilia at the periphery, 'skirting' and indented by adjacent red cells
Nuclei round, oval, indented or folded with moderately condensed to somewhat open chromatin
Occasional cells with more basophilic cytoplasm and immunoblastic appearance (plasmacytoid/Downey type II-III spectrum)
Heterogeneous morphology from cell to cell; no Auer rods or granules; red cells unremarkable
64446.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (composite of multiple fields) shows increased large reactive lymphocytes with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm that shows peripheral basophilia and scalloping around adjacent red cells. Nuclei are round, oval or indented with moderately condensed chromatin, and some cells show a more immunoblastic appearance with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The lymphocytes form a heterogeneous spectrum rather than a monotonous population. Findings are consistent with reactive lymphocytosis (Downey cells), in the clinical setting of Epstein-Barr virus infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.vs: Blasts are monotonous with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant cytoplasm and more condensed chromatin.
LGL leukemia shows a persistent monotonous population of large lymphocytes with azurophilic granules and clonal TCR rearrangement, not variable skirting basophilic cells.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of lymphoma (e.g. Sézary, mantle cell)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells show a uniform abnormal nuclear shape (cerebriform, cleaved) with light-chain restriction or aberrant T-cell phenotype on flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Other viral reactive lymphocytosis (CMV, acute HIV, toxoplasmosis)
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable; heterophile antibody and EBV serology are required to confirm EBV.

64190.recognize_zh: 在紅血球之間可見一顆較大的血小板，內含明顯粗大、深紫色的顆粒（hypergranulated platelet）；單看血小板並無特異性，需搭配白血球中的巨大顆粒才能指向 Chediak-Higashi 症候群。
features: Single enlarged platelet (roughly one-third to half a red cell diameter) with irregular outline
Coarse, dense purple granules distributed throughout the platelet cytoplasm
A few normal-sized small platelets nearby for comparison
Background red cells overlapping in a thick area of the smear with a few crenated cells
No leukocytes in this field to assess for giant granules
64190.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged platelet with an irregular outline and coarse, dense purple granules, alongside a few normal-sized platelets. Red cells are overlapping in this thicker area of the film with occasional crenated forms. No leukocytes are present in the field for assessment of giant cytoplasmic granules. This platelet finding is nonspecific on its own; in the setting of Chediak-Higashi syndrome it is compatible with the reported hypergranulated platelets, although the platelet dense-granule deficiency underlying the bleeding tendency is not visible by light microscopy.

ddx.dx: Normal large platelet with increased turnover (e.g., ITP)
ddx.vs: Reactive large platelets show normal fine granulation and occur without giant inclusions in neutrophils or lymphocytes.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets with thrombocytopenia and pale blue Dohle-like inclusions in neutrophils rather than giant azurophilic granules.
Gray platelet syndrome shows large platelets that are pale gray and agranular due to alpha-granule deficiency, the opposite of hypergranulation.
EDTA-related artifacts produce platelets aggregated around neutrophils or in clumps rather than a single coarsely granular platelet.

64126.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑表面有多核蝕骨細胞（osteoclast）位於吸收凹陷（Howship lacunae）內，並向骨小樑內部挖出通道（tunneling／dissecting resorption），周圍骨髓腔被纖維性基質取代；這是慢性腎病繼發性副甲狀腺亢進（腎性骨失養症）的特徵。
features: Bony trabeculae with irregular scalloped surfaces
Multiple multinucleated osteoclasts sitting in Howship lacunae along trabecular surfaces
Resorption tunneling into the center of trabeculae (dissecting osteitis)
Loose peritrabecular fibrous stroma replacing hematopoietic marrow
Hematopoietic elements scant in this field
64126.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows bony trabeculae with scalloped surfaces lined by numerous multinucleated osteoclasts occupying Howship lacunae, with resorption cavities tunneling into the trabecular bone. The adjacent marrow space is replaced by loose peritrabecular fibrous stroma, and hematopoietic cells are sparse. Findings are consistent with increased osteoclastic bone resorption (osteitis fibrosa) of secondary hyperparathyroidism/renal osteodystrophy, which can contribute to cytopenias through marrow fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Paget disease has osteoclasts with very numerous nuclei and a mosaic cement-line pattern, without the CKD/PTH context and peritrabecular fibrosis.
PMF shows atypical clustered megakaryocytes and reticulin fibrosis within the marrow rather than osteoclast-driven peritrabecular fibrosis.
Tumor-associated osteolysis shows neoplastic cells in the marrow space adjacent to resorbing osteoclasts.

64062.recognize_zh: 三顆中型淋巴球，核圓且邊緣平滑、染色質較疏鬆、核仁不明顯，細胞質豐富淡灰藍色，周邊呈毛絨絨的細絲狀突起（hairy projections）環繞整個細胞，這就是毛細胞白血病的毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cells, about 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
Abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with circumferential fine, fuzzy hair-like projections
Round nuclei with smooth contours, some slightly oval
Moderately open, finely stippled chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Background red cells include occasional crenated echinocytes (likely artifact); no granulocytes or monocytes in field
64062.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered medium-sized lymphoid cells with round, smooth-contoured nuclei, moderately open chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections and ill-defined borders. Background red cells show occasional crenation, likely artifactual, and no monocytes are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have prominent central nucleoli, higher counts without monocytopenia, and are CD25-negative and BRAF wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes are smaller with more condensed chromatin and short polar projections rather than circumferential hairs, and lack CD103/CD25 co-expression.
Monocytes have folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and grey vacuolated cytoplasm without fine hair-like projections.
LGLs have round nuclei with condensed chromatin and azurophilic cytoplasmic granules rather than agranular cytoplasm with fuzzy borders.

63998.recognize_zh: 四個小圖中的小淋巴球胞質裡有多顆紫紅色（metachromatic）小顆粒，部分周圍帶透亮暈圈，這是 Alder-Reilly 異常，提示黏多醣症（如 Hunter 症候群）。
features: Small mature lymphocytes with round nuclei and condensed chromatin (panels A-D)
Multiple coarse magenta/metachromatic cytoplasmic inclusions, some with surrounding clear halos
Inclusions overlie the thin cytoplasmic rim and nuclear area
Background red cells with normal central pallor and scattered normal platelets
No toxic vacuolation or Dohle bodies in the cells shown
63998.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows small mature-appearing lymphocytes (panels A-D) containing multiple coarse, metachromatic magenta cytoplasmic inclusions, several surrounded by a thin rim of clearing. The lymphocyte nuclei are round with condensed chromatin, and the inclusions are distinct from azurophilic granules of large granular lymphocytes. Red cells and platelets in the fields shown are unremarkable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly anomaly, suggestive of a mucopolysaccharidosis, in this case known Hunter syndrome (MPS II).

ddx.vs: LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and no clear halos, whereas these are small lymphocytes with coarse metachromatic inclusions in halos.
Toxic granulation occurs in neutrophils with infection and is accompanied by Dohle bodies and vacuoles, and does not affect lymphocytes.
Chediak-Higashi shows giant, fused peroxidase-positive granules in neutrophils and lymphocytes, much larger than these small metachromatic inclusions.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated lymphocytes in other lysosomal storage disease (e.g., Pompe, Batten, I-cell)
ddx.vs: These show sharply punched-out clear vacuoles without stained metachromatic granules, and require enzyme or genetic testing for confirmation.

63870.recognize_zh: 中央兩顆細胞質藍色、核偏心的漿細胞內，可見大量細長、交錯排列的紫紅色針狀包涵體，形似 Auer rods；周圍其他是正常的嗜中性球系與嗜伊紅性細胞，說明這些桿狀物位於漿細胞，是骨髓瘤的假 Auer 桿。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant blue cytoplasm
Numerous thin, needle-shaped azurophilic rod-like inclusions criss-crossing within the cytoplasm
One plasma cell packed with dense rods overlying the nucleus; another with a looser bundle beside the nucleus
Adjacent plasma cell without inclusions, plus maturing neutrophils, a myelocyte, eosinophil and small lymphocytes
63870.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm among maturing granulocytes, an eosinophil and lymphocytes. Two plasma cells contain numerous slender, needle-like azurophilic crystalline inclusions arranged in overlapping criss-cross bundles, resembling Auer rods. The surrounding myeloid cells show normal maturation without such inclusions. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with intracytoplasmic pseudo-Auer rods.

ddx.vs: Faggot cells are hypergranular promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and MPO-positive rods, whereas these rods are in mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric nuclei.
Auer rods are usually single in myeloblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, not multiple crystals in plasma cells.
Crystals in histiocytosis are within macrophages with pale abundant cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei.

ddx.dx: Plasma cells with Russell bodies (Mott cells)
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain round globular immunoglobulin inclusions rather than needle-shaped crystalline rods.

63806.recognize_zh: 穿刺切片中，許多核大、空泡狀染色質、形狀不規則的非典型大型淋巴細胞成群聚集，夾雜在大量小淋巴球與發炎細胞之間，符合灰區淋巴瘤復發/持續病灶的表現。
features: Core biopsy with dense cellularity
Clusters of large pleomorphic atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin and irregular nuclear contours
Moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm in the large cells
Background of small dark lymphocytes and other inflammatory cells
Crush artifact along the edges; image resolution limits assessment of nucleoli and eosinophils
63806.describe_en: H&E-stained core biopsy shows a densely cellular infiltrate with clusters of large pleomorphic atypical lymphoid cells containing vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, set in a background of small lymphocytes and mixed inflammatory cells. Crush artifact is present at the edges, and the image resolution limits assessment of nucleoli and specific inflammatory cell types. The morphology is intermediate between classic Hodgkin lymphoma and large B-cell lymphoma, and with the immunoprofile (CD30+, CD15+, variable CD20 and CD79a) supports relapsed/persistent mediastinal gray zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Tumor cells are fewer and scattered in a more polymorphous background, and lose B-cell program markers such as CD20, CD79a and OCT2.
Shows more monotonous sheets of large cells with clear cytoplasm and compartmentalizing fibrosis, with strong CD20 and weak/absent CD15.
Scattered large cells are strongly CD20 positive and CD30/CD15 negative in a T-cell and histiocyte-rich background.
Cohesive hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei that express T-cell markers and lack PAX5.

63678.recognize_zh: 三個骨髓抽吸片視野中都可見小型巨核細胞，核為單一圓形、未分葉且偏心，外觀像大型漿細胞（plasmacytoid），位於骨髓小粒與脂肪旁，是 del(5q) MDS 的典型小型單葉巨核細胞。
features: Small megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated (monolobated) eccentric nuclei
Plasmacytoid appearance: moderate gray-blue to lilac cytoplasm around an off-center nucleus
Megakaryocytes located within or adjacent to cellular marrow particles with abundant fat
Background granulocytic and erythroid precursors with grossly normal maturation
No obvious increase in blasts in these low-to-intermediate power fields
63678.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (three panels) show cellular particles admixed with fat. Megakaryocytes are readily identified and include many small forms with round, non-lobated, eccentrically placed nuclei and moderate cytoplasm, imparting a plasmacytoid appearance. Background erythroid and granulocytic precursors appear relatively unremarkable, and blasts are not increased at this magnification, although fine dysplastic detail cannot be assessed at this power. In conjunction with cytogenetic demonstration of an isolated 5q deletion, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of other MDS or CML
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes in other MDS/CML are very small (lymphocyte-sized) with dense nuclei, often with separated lobes, and CML shows BCR::ABL1; isolated del(5q) on karyotype is the discriminator.
Plasma cells are smaller with clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, whereas these megakaryocytes have granular lilac cytoplasm and platelet budding.
ET megakaryocytes are large and hyperlobated with abundant mature cytoplasm, not small and monolobated.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear pleomorphism and nucleoli rather than isolated megakaryocytes within particles.

63614.recognize_zh: 視野中央是一顆體積極大的細胞，豐富的粉紫色細顆粒細胞質包圍著一個由許多小圓葉串連成環狀的細胞核，這種大細胞加上多葉核的組合就是成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）的核分葉過多（hyperlobulation）。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells, with low N:C ratio
Nucleus composed of numerous small, round, interconnected lobes arranged in a ring-like (hyperlobulated) pattern
Moderately condensed chromatin within each lobe; no nucleoli
Abundant pale pink-violet cytoplasm filled with fine azurophilic granules, indicating a mature (granular) megakaryocyte
Background of bone marrow aspirate with small erythroid/lymphoid nuclei at the periphery
63614.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a single very large mature megakaryocyte. The nucleus is hyperlobulated, consisting of numerous small, round, interconnected lobes arranged in a ring, with moderately condensed chromatin. The cytoplasm is abundant and finely granular, consistent with platelet-producing maturation; no emperipolesis or dysplastic separated nuclear lobes are seen in this cell. Findings are consistent with a mature megakaryocyte with hyperlobulated nuclei; a single cell is not diagnostic of a myeloproliferative neoplasm and must be interpreted with megakaryocyte number, clustering and clinical context.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are also large with staghorn-like hyperlobulated nuclei, but the diagnosis requires increased numbers and loose clusters in the biopsy, not a single hyperlobulated cell.
MDS megakaryocytes show multiple widely separated round nuclear lobes ('pawn ball') or micromegakaryocytes, whereas here the lobes remain interconnected.
Osteoclasts contain many discrete, separate oval nuclei with nucleoli rather than one continuous lobulated nucleus.
Megaloblastic states can cause hyperlobulation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, identified by accompanying megaloblastic erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes.

63550.recognize_zh: 膿液抹片中可見極細、呈念珠狀（beaded）並呈直角分枝的絲狀桿菌，交織成網，這種細長分枝絲狀菌在抗酸染色下即是 Nocardia 的典型形態。
features: Very thin (about 1 micrometer) filamentous bacteria forming a loose meshwork across the field
Filaments are beaded and show branching, including near right-angle branches
Organisms stain dark purple-red against a pink-stained proteinaceous/purulent background
Filament width is much narrower than fungal hyphae, without septa or bulbous ends
Low image resolution and faded staining limit assessment of the degree of acid-fastness
63550.describe_en: Smear of abscess drainage material stained with an acid-fast method shows a network of thin, beaded, branching filamentous bacilli lying on a pink amorphous background of proteinaceous and necrotic debris. The filaments are much narrower than fungal hyphae and show frequent branching, some at right angles. Image resolution and staining quality limit precise assessment of acid-fast intensity. Findings are consistent with Nocardia species (weakly or partially acid-fast on modified Kinyoun stain), with confirmation by culture and species identification.

ddx.vs: Actinomyces also forms thin branching filaments but is not acid-fast on modified stains and typically forms sulfur granules in anaerobic infections.
Mycobacteria are short, straight to slightly curved strongly acid-fast rods that do not branch into filaments.
Fungal hyphae are several times wider (3-6 micrometers), septate and show acute-angle or broad branching, and are highlighted by GMS or PAS rather than acid-fast stains.

63358.recognize_zh: 甲苯胺藍（toluidine blue）染色下，紅血球呈藍綠色，一群淋巴球染成深紫色，細胞邊緣的球形包涵體保持透明、無異染性（metachromasia）；旁邊顆粒較明顯的細胞呈淡粉紫色，可作為對照。
features: Cluster of small round lymphocytes with dark purple nuclei
Clear, unstained globular inclusions at the periphery of several lymphocytes
No metachromatic (red-purple) staining within the inclusions
A few cells with pinkish-purple granular cytoplasm adjacent to the cluster
Blue-green stained red cells with overlap in the background
63358.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained with toluidine blue shows a cluster of small lymphocytes, several containing clear globular cytoplasmic inclusions. The inclusions show no metachromatic staining. Adjacent cells with granular pink-purple cytoplasm are also present, and red cells stain blue-green. Findings indicate that the lymphocyte inclusions are toluidine blue-negative, consistent with the negative results on other cytochemical stains.

ddx.vs: Basophil and mast cell granules stain metachromatically red-purple with toluidine blue, unlike the clear inclusions here.
Glycosaminoglycan inclusions in lymphocytes are metachromatic with toluidine blue and are small granules rather than large clear globules.
These are toluidine blue-negative too, so Oil Red O and PAS are needed to exclude them.

63294.recognize_zh: 這是 NGS 定序比對結果的 IGV 截圖：位置在第 17 號染色體 17p13.1（TP53 基因），大量讀段在同一鹼基位置出現紅色（T）不配對，對應約第 175 號密碼子，提示 TP53 熱點突變（如 p.R175H），支持 AML-MRC 常見的 TP53 異常。
features: Integrative Genomics Viewer screenshot of aligned sequencing reads over a 96 bp window on chromosome 17p13.1 (~chr17:7,578,360-7,578,450, hg19 coordinates)
Single genomic position (~7,578,406) with mismatched bases (red, T on the plus strand) in a large proportion of reads, flagged in the coverage track
Reference sequence and translated amino acid track at the bottom show TP53 exon 5 (reverse strand) around codons 174-176 (R-R-C)
Scattered isolated colored mismatches elsewhere consistent with background sequencing error
Variant allele fraction appears substantial but cannot be quantified precisely from the screenshot
63294.describe_en: This figure is an Integrative Genomics Viewer display of next-generation sequencing reads aligned to chromosome 17p13.1 within the TP53 gene. A single-nucleotide variant is present at approximately chr17:7,578,406 (hg19), where a large fraction of reads show a C>T change on the plus strand (G>A on the coding strand), and the codon track places it at arginine 175, consistent with the TP53 hotspot variant c.524G>A, p.R175H. The variant allele fraction appears substantial, though exact values should be taken from the variant call report rather than the screenshot. A TP53 mutation in this context is associated with complex karyotype, adverse prognosis and, under current WHO/ICC schemes, classification as AML/MDS with mutated TP53.

63230.recognize_zh: 脊椎矢狀切面 MRI：A 為胸椎（脂肪抑制序列），椎體與後方附件可見散在不均勻的異常訊號；B 為腰薦椎顯影後脂肪抑制 T1，多個椎體與棘突內佈滿斑駁、多發的顯影病灶（variegated pattern）；廣泛多發的骨髓浸潤病灶符合多發性骨髓瘤的 MRI 表現。
features: Panel A: sagittal fat-suppressed (STIR/T2-weighted type) MRI of the thoracic spine with patchy heterogeneous signal in vertebral bodies and posterior elements
Panel B: sagittal contrast-enhanced fat-suppressed T1-weighted MRI of the lumbosacral spine
Multiple mottled, heterogeneously enhancing focal lesions throughout the lumbar vertebral bodies and spinous processes ('variegated' or salt-and-pepper pattern)
Vertebral body heights largely preserved; no obvious epidural mass or cord compression on these images
Intervertebral discs appear spared
63230.describe_en: Sagittal MRI of the spine demonstrates multifocal marrow abnormalities. The thoracic spine (A, fat-suppressed fluid-sensitive sequence) shows patchy heterogeneous signal within vertebral bodies and posterior elements, and the contrast-enhanced fat-suppressed T1-weighted image of the lumbosacral spine (B) shows numerous mottled, enhancing focal lesions throughout the vertebral bodies and spinous processes with sparing of the intervertebral discs. No definite vertebral collapse or epidural extension is seen on these images. The multifocal marrow infiltration is compatible with multiple myeloma; more than one focal lesion of at least 5 mm on MRI is a myeloma-defining event when correlated with a clonal plasma cell disorder.

ddx.vs: Metastases tend to be fewer, larger and often involve pedicles with a known primary, whereas myeloma shows diffuse or innumerable small variegated lesions with a monoclonal protein; biopsy separates them.
Lymphoma and leukemia usually produce diffuse homogeneous marrow replacement and require marrow biopsy with immunophenotyping for distinction.
Red marrow reconversion (e.g., anemia, G-CSF) is diffuse and symmetric with mild enhancement and signal higher than disc on T1, lacking discrete focal lesions.
Infection centers on the intervertebral disc with endplate destruction and paraspinal collections, whereas the discs here are spared.

63102.recognize_zh: 周邊血中大型原始細胞染色質細緻、細胞質邊緣有一圈深藍色嗜鹼性環而內側較淡（A），B 圖可見細長的 Auer rod，C 圖過氧化酶染色見大顆粒狀的 pseudo-Chediak 顆粒；這組特徵是 AML with t(8;21) 的典型形態。
features: Large myeloblasts with round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and high to moderate N:C ratio
Cytoplasm with a distinct deeply basophilic peripheral rim and paler inner zone
Panel B: blast with a paler perinuclear hof region and a long, slender Auer rod
Panel C (peroxidase): blasts with isolated large, coarse pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; platelets present
63102.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large myeloblasts with finely dispersed chromatin and cytoplasm bearing a sharply basophilic outer rim. One blast contains a long, slender Auer rod (panel B), and peroxidase staining highlights coarse pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules in some blasts (panel C). These morphologic features in circulating myeloblasts are strongly suggestive of AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, which was confirmed by karyotype.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with heavy azurophilic granules or bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) rather than round-nucleated blasts with a basophilic rim and single long Auer rods.
Inv(16) AML shows monocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic granules in the marrow.

ddx.dx: AML with maturation, not otherwise specified
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, so the distinction requires cytogenetic or molecular detection of RUNX1::RUNX1T1, supported by CD19/PAX5 and CD56 coexpression on flow.

63038.recognize_zh: 腦組織中大型、核仁明顯的非典型淋巴細胞塞滿小血管與微血管管腔（A、C），間質幾乎沒有腫瘤細胞；CD20 陽性（D）、CD5 在血管內細胞陽性（E）、Ki67 極高（F），是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的典型表現。
features: Panels A-C (H&E): large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm filling and distending small vessels and capillaries of brain parenchyma
Tumor cells confined to vascular lumina with minimal or no extravascular infiltration of the surrounding neuropil
Panel D: strong membranous CD20 positivity of the intravascular cells
Panel E: CD5 positivity in cells within capillary lumina
Panel F: Ki67 proliferation index very high in the intravascular population
63038.describe_en: Sections of brain parenchyma show small vessels and capillaries filled and distended by large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate cytoplasm, with little to no extravascular infiltration of the surrounding neuropil. By immunohistochemistry the intravascular cells are strongly positive for CD20, CD5 highlights cells within capillary lumina, and the Ki67 proliferation index is very high. There is no mass-forming parenchymal lymphoma in these fields. Findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma involving the central nervous system.

ddx.dx: Primary CNS diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Primary CNS DLBCL forms parenchymal masses with angiocentric perivascular cuffing that infiltrates the neuropil, rather than tumor cells confined within vessel lumina.
Intravascular NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD20 negative and CD3/CD56/cytotoxic marker and EBER positive.
Carcinoma emboli are cohesive keratin-positive cells and CD20/CD45 negative.
Leukostasis shows blasts in vessels with a circulating leukemic population (MPO/CD34/TdT positive), not CD20+ large B cells.

62974.recognize_zh: 中期細胞 FISH 上，MYC 分離探針與 KMT2A 探針訊號在 add(8)(q24) 與兩個環狀染色體上呈多組重複聚集；右側核型可見 add(8)(q24) 與兩個標記環狀染色體，代表 MYC 與 KMT2A 以擴增形式存在於環狀染色體中。
features: Metaphase FISH (A): MYC dual-color break-apart probe plus KMT2A (green)-MLLT3 (orange) dual-fusion probe
Multiple clustered green (KMT2A) and orange signals on an add(8)(q24) chromosome and on two ring chromosomes (arrows), indicating extra copies/amplification
Normal-appearing single signals on other chromosomes for comparison
Karyotype (B): add(8)(q24) and two marker ring chromosomes (mar); sex chromosomes shown as X with Y faded in the template
No KMT2A-MLLT3 fusion pattern evident; signal clustering indicates gain rather than rearrangement
62974.describe_en: Composite cytogenetic figure. Metaphase FISH using a MYC break-apart probe and a KMT2A/MLLT3 dual-fusion probe shows multiple clustered signals located on an abnormal chromosome 8 with additional material at 8q24 and on two ring chromosomes, consistent with multiple extra copies (amplification) of MYC and KMT2A. The G-banded karyotype confirms add(8)(q24) and two marker ring chromosomes. Interpretation: MYC and KMT2A amplification carried on ring chromosomes/add(8q), a complex, adverse-risk finding in acute myeloid leukemia that should be distinguished from KMT2A rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Rearrangement shows split or fused signals at a single locus rather than multiple clustered copies of the KMT2A signal.

ddx.dx: Double minute chromosomes with MYC amplification
ddx.vs: Double minutes appear as tiny paired acentric bodies scattered in the metaphase, whereas here amplicons reside in ring chromosomes and add(8q).
Polysomy gives one signal per extra whole chromosome 8, not tandem clustered signals on marker chromosomes.

62910.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中央有一個顆粒性白血球，細胞質內充滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒並覆蓋在分葉核上；單看此圖極像嗜鹼性球，需結合注射碘造影劑後採檢的病史，才能判讀為嗜中性球內的黑色色素（contrast-associated pigment）。
features: Single granulocyte about 1.5 times red cell diameter
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse, irregular dark purple-black granules
Granules overlie and partly obscure a lobulated nucleus; faint pink cytoplasm between granules
Background red cells with several echinocytes (crenated cells)
Few scattered platelets; no other leukocytes in field
62910.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocyte whose cytoplasm is packed with coarse, irregular dark purple-black granular material that overlies and partially obscures a lobulated nucleus. The surrounding red cells are normochromic with several echinocytes, and scattered platelets are present. In isolation, the cell closely resembles a basophil or a neutrophil with heavy toxic granulation; the reported history of blood drawn after iodinated contrast injection, with similar black material in other neutrophils and myeloid precursors, supports interpretation as ingested pigment. Findings are suggestive of contrast-associated pigment in a neutrophil, with toxic changes in a septic patient.

ddx.vs: Basophil granules are uniformly purple-black and water-soluble, while pigment-laden neutrophils show similar material in bands and myelocytes in the same smear and a neutrophil-type pink cytoplasm between granules.
Toxic granules are fine to coarse dark azurophilic granules that do not typically pack the cytoplasm as black clumps obscuring the nucleus.
Large dark granules are present in all neutrophils as a constitutional finding (mucopolysaccharidoses), independent of contrast exposure.
Hemozoin appears as brown-black refractile clumps, usually with parasitized red cells in the smear.

62846.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 骨髓切片中，大量顆粒球系與紅血球系細胞之間，夾雜著一小群一小群胞質較豐富、核偏位的漿細胞樣細胞；左圖下方可見一個巨核細胞，整體看不出明顯的漿細胞片狀浸潤，需要 CD138 才能確認。
features: Two high-power H&E fields of a markedly hypercellular marrow without fat
Predominant maturing granulocytic cells with admixed erythroid precursors
Subtle small clusters of cells with round eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin and moderate amphophilic-to-eosinophilic cytoplasm (plasma cells)
Plasma cells not forming obvious sheets on H&E
Megakaryocyte present at the lower portion of the left panel
62846.describe_en: High-power H&E sections of the bone marrow trephine show a markedly hypercellular marrow composed predominantly of maturing granulocytic elements with admixed erythroid precursors and occasional megakaryocytes. Scattered small, subtle clusters of cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse chromatin, and moderate cytoplasm are present, compatible with plasma cells, but they do not form discrete sheets on H&E. Because plasma cell burden is easily underestimated on routine sections, CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostains are required. In context, findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma masked by myeloid hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Reactive myeloid hyperplasia with polytypic plasmacytosis
ddx.vs: Reactive marrow has scattered polytypic plasma cells without tight clusters, confirmed by kappa/lambda staining.
MPN shows granulocytic and megakaryocytic proliferation with atypical megakaryocyte clusters but no clonal plasma cell aggregates.
CMML shows increased monocytic cells (CD14/CD163 positive) and dysplasia rather than clusters of CD138-positive plasma cells.

62782.recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中箭頭所指的紅血球有些邊緣出現透明的水泡樣區（blister cells）或咬痕狀缺口（bite cells），也有不少帶棘突的變形紅血球，提示氧化性溶血；在Wilson disease由銅離子引起。
features: Low power: moderate anisopoikilocytosis with scattered neutrophils and a lymphocyte (A)
Blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear membrane vesicle (B, arrowheads)
Bite-like cells with notched eccentric defects (B)
Several spiculated red cells (echinocytes/acanthocytes) and irregularly contracted cells
A polychromatic macrocyte indicating reticulocytosis (B)
62782.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisopoikilocytosis. At higher magnification, numerous red cells show blister formation with eccentrically retracted hemoglobin and clear membrane vesicles, as well as bite-like notched defects (arrowheads), accompanied by spiculated echinocytic and acanthocytic forms. A polychromatic macrocyte indicates a reticulocyte response. Findings are consistent with oxidative hemolysis, which in this clinical context is attributable to copper-mediated injury in Wilson disease.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical (bite and blister cells); separation requires G6PD enzyme assay and serum copper/ceruloplasmin studies.
Morphology overlaps; the discriminator is exposure history and methemoglobin level rather than smear features.
MAHA shows schistocytes (helmet and triangular fragments) with thrombocytopenia, not blister cells with retracted hemoglobin.

ddx.dx: Liver disease with spur cell anemia
ddx.vs: Spur cell anemia shows predominant acanthocytes with irregular spicules and lacks blister and bite cells.

62718.recognize_zh: 未設閘門的 cMPO 對 CD33 流式圖：綠色族群（B 系原始細胞）MPO 僅弱表現約 10³–10⁴；紅色原始細胞族群 MPO 由弱延伸到明顯陽性（約 10⁴·⁵–10⁵），並接近棕/灰色成熟顆粒球的亮 MPO 區，紫色淋巴球為陰性對照，顯示一部分原始細胞確實表現 MPO，支持骨髓系。
features: Ungated events; cytoplasmic MPO-PE (x-axis) versus CD33-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Green population (B-lineage-committed blasts) with CD33 dim-to-positive and MPO low (about 10^3 to 10^4)
Red blast population with CD33 positive and MPO extending from low to clearly positive (about 3x10^4 to 10^5)
Brown/grey events with bright MPO (10^5 to 10^6), consistent with residual mature granulocytes as internal positive control
Purple events negative for both MPO and CD33, consistent with lymphocytes as internal negative control
62718.describe_en: Ungated flow cytometric analysis displays cytoplasmic MPO versus CD33. Lymphocytes (purple) are negative for both markers and residual granulocytes (brown/grey) are MPO bright, providing internal controls. The green blast population shows only low MPO, whereas the red blast population contains a subset with clearly positive MPO at an intensity above the lymphocyte level and approaching that of mature granulocytes, with CD33 co-expression. MPO expression in a distinct blast subset establishes myeloid lineage, and together with strong CD19 and cCD79a on another blast subset the findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.dx: B-ALL with low-level MPO by flow
ddx.vs: Low-intensity MPO overlapping lymphocyte levels without a distinct bright subset is insufficient for myeloid lineage and may be seen in B-ALL.

ddx.dx: AML with aberrant CD19 and CD79a
ddx.vs: MPO-positive blasts lacking strong CD19 with at least one additional B-cell marker should be classified as AML, not MPAL.
Normal granulocytes have high side scatter and very bright MPO, whereas leukemic MPO-positive blasts have low side scatter and dim CD45.

62654.recognize_zh: 中央一團細胞中，上方有兩個光滑、均質深紫、不見染色質紋理的圓形核物質，旁邊細胞圍繞且細胞質有空泡，類似 LE 現象中嗜中性球圍繞游離核物質的聚集（rosette）；但解析度有限，典型新月形被擠壓核看不清楚。
features: Cluster of cells in a marrow aspirate smear with surrounding red cells
Two smooth, rounded, homogeneous deep purple masses at the top of the cluster lacking chromatin detail
Adjacent cells with vacuolated cytoplasm and indented nuclei clustered around the masses
A separate mononuclear cell with an indented nucleus at upper right
Limited resolution and focus; classic crescentic displaced nucleus not clearly resolved
62654.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of cells surrounded by red cells. At the top of the cluster are smooth, rounded, homogeneous purple masses without chromatin structure, and the adjacent cells show vacuolated cytoplasm and indented nuclei, an arrangement reminiscent of phagocytes aggregating around free denatured nuclear material. Image resolution and focus are limited, and a classic LE cell with a peripheral crescentic host nucleus is not clearly resolved in this field. Findings are suggestive of LE phenomenon (rosette formation) in the given clinical context of systemic lupus erythematosus, though a cell clump cannot be fully excluded.

ddx.vs: The engulfed nucleus in a tart cell preserves chromatin texture, whereas LE material is smooth and homogeneous.

ddx.dx: Clump of myeloid precursors or megakaryocyte fragment
ddx.vs: Precursor clumps show individual nuclei with chromatin and nucleoli and no homogeneous extracellular nuclear bodies.
Tumor clusters show cohesive, atypical nuclei with nucleoli rather than homogeneous amorphous nuclear masses.

62590.recognize_zh: Ki67 免疫染色：腫瘤性濾泡內大部分細胞核呈陽性（估計約六至七成），強弱不一，周邊少數小淋巴球陰性；增殖指數高，與高級別（3a 級）濾泡性淋巴瘤中心母細胞多的狀況一致，且沒有反應性生發中心的明暗區極性分布。
features: High Ki67 nuclear labeling in roughly 60-70% of neoplastic follicular cells
Variable nuclear staining intensity among positive cells
Evenly distributed proliferation without light/dark zone polarization
Negative small lymphocytes at the periphery of the follicle
62590.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for Ki67 shows nuclear staining in a large proportion, approximately 60-70%, of the neoplastic follicular cells, with variable intensity. The proliferating cells are evenly distributed throughout the follicle without the polarized light and dark zone pattern of reactive germinal centers, and the small peripheral lymphocytes are negative. A high proliferation index correlates with the increased number of centroblasts seen on H&E. The findings are consistent with high-grade (grade 3a) follicular lymphoma; grading itself remains based on centroblast counts.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers have a very high Ki67 index as well but show polarization with the dark zone more proliferative than the light zone.
Low-grade FL typically shows a Ki67 index below 20-30% within neoplastic follicles.
Burkitt lymphoma shows a diffuse pattern with Ki67 close to 100% and is BCL2 negative.

62526.recognize_zh: CD1a 染色整個視野皆無棕色陽性，中央竇內的大型組織球（淡藍圓核）與周圍淋巴球全為陰性；CD1a 陰性可排除蘭格罕細胞組織球增生症（LCH），支持 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: No CD1a staining in any cell population
Large sinus histiocytes with round vesicular nuclei are CD1a-negative
Surrounding small lymphocytes are negative
Hematoxylin counterstain only; pale sinus center flanked by dense lymphoid areas
62526.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD1a is negative in the large sinus histiocytes as well as in the surrounding lymphocytes. The architecture shows an expanded pale sinus with large histiocytes bordered by dense lymphoid tissue. No internal positive control is present in this field, so staining validity depends on a separate control. This pertinent negative result argues against Langerhans cell histiocytosis and supports Rosai-Dorfman disease in combination with S100 positivity and emperipolesis.

ddx.vs: LCH cells show strong membranous CD1a and langerin positivity, with grooved nuclei and eosinophils.
Indeterminate cells are S100 and CD1a positive but langerin negative.
Reactive histiocytes are CD1a-negative like this image but also S100-negative, without emperipolesis.

62462.recognize_zh: 這是 CD45 對 SSC 的流式圖（活細胞）：淋巴球 gate 佔 64.45%，顆粒球僅 24.47%、單核球 6.53%，淋巴球比例明顯上升；淋巴球區內藍色族群 CD45 表現較綠色族群略弱，提示異常 T 細胞族群。
features: Dot plot of side scatter (SS INT) versus CD45-KO, gated on live cells
Lymphocyte gate (bright CD45, low SSC) contains 64.45% of events, indicating relative lymphocytosis
Granulocyte gate 24.47% (moderate CD45, high SSC) and monocyte gate 6.53% (intermediate SSC)
Within the lymphocyte gate, blue events show slightly dimmer CD45 than green events
Scattered CD45-dim/negative low-SSC events consistent with debris or residual non-leukocytes; non-morphologic figure
62462.describe_en: Flow cytometric CD45 versus side-scatter plot of live peripheral blood leukocytes shows a markedly increased lymphocyte fraction (64.45%) with reduced granulocytes (24.47%) and monocytes (6.53%). Within the lymphocyte gate, the population painted blue shows slightly dimmer CD45 than the green population, corresponding to the abnormal and residual normal T-cell subsets defined in companion plots. No distinct CD45-dim blast population is evident. The findings indicate an expanded lymphocyte population warranting lineage and aberrancy analysis, which in this case supports Sezary cell involvement.

ddx.vs: Blasts occupy a CD45-dim, low-to-intermediate SSC region, whereas this expanded population lies in the bright CD45 lymphocyte region.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other B-cell lymphocytosis
ddx.vs: The CD45/SSC pattern is similar, so lineage markers such as CD19, CD5 and CD23 versus CD3/CD4 separate B-cell from T-cell expansions.
Reactive expansions lack CD7/CD26 loss and aberrant CD3 or CD4 intensity on the lymphocyte subsets.

62398.recognize_zh: 高倍下是一群核形不規則、N:C 比高、染色質較開放的母細胞樣細胞，細胞質帶嗜酸性顆粒感，其間夾雜含粗大橘紅色顆粒的未成熟嗜酸性球；組織中出現未成熟嗜酸性前驅細胞是提示骨髓性肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma）的重要線索。
features: Atypical blast-like cells with high N:C ratio
Irregular, folded to elongated nuclear contours
Open, finely dispersed chromatin
Eosinophilic, finely granular cytoplasm
Admixed immature eosinophils with coarse orange-red granules
Diffuse discohesive infiltrate with crush/streaming of nuclei
62398.describe_en: High-power examination shows a diffuse infiltrate of atypical blast-like cells with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratios, irregular nuclear contours and open chromatin. The cytoplasm is eosinophilic and finely granular. Scattered immature eosinophils with coarse eosinophilic granules are admixed. There is no evidence of epithelial differentiation or glandular formation in this field. The findings are suggestive of myeloid sarcoma, to be confirmed by MPO, CD34, CD117 and lysozyme immunostains.

ddx.vs: DLBCL lacks admixed immature eosinophils and granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and is CD20-positive, MPO-negative.
LCH cells have grooved coffee-bean nuclei with abundant pale cytoplasm and are CD1a/langerin-positive, although eosinophils are also prominent.
CHL shows scattered large Reed-Sternberg cells in a polymorphous background rather than sheets of blasts, and is CD30/CD15-positive.
EMH contains trilineage maturing elements including megakaryocytes and erythroid islands rather than sheets of blasts.

62270.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色大致呈瀰漫性陽性（套層 B 細胞與 T 細胞皆陽性），只有結節內散在的淡染小區塊為陰性，對應被切碎的反應性生發中心，說明生發中心細胞不表現 BCL2，支持反應性的 PTGC 而非濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse BCL2 staining of small lymphocytes (mantle B cells and T cells) throughout the field
Multiple irregular, pale BCL2-negative islands within the large nodule corresponding to fragmented germinal centers
Rounded BCL2-weak/negative area at the lower left in a smaller follicle
No nodules with uniform strong BCL2 positivity of germinal center cells
Staining contrast is low at this magnification, limiting precise delineation
62270.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows diffuse positivity in the small lymphocytes of the mantle zones and interfollicular T-cell areas, with multiple irregular pale islands within the enlarged nodule that are BCL2-negative and correspond to fragmented germinal center remnants. There is no evidence of follicles composed of BCL2-positive germinal center B cells, although the low contrast at this magnification limits fine assessment. Findings support a reactive process consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma shows BCL2-positive germinal center (CD10+) B cells filling the follicles, whereas here the germinal center fragments are BCL2-negative (comparison with CD10 on a serial section confirms).
BCL2 does not separate these entities because both contain BCL2-positive small lymphocytes; the discriminator is the presence of LP cells, which are BCL2-negative.

62206.recognize_zh: 視野內多數為中型淋巴細胞，細胞核圓、染色質中度濃縮，部分核中央可見小核仁，細胞質淡藍呈中等量（前淋巴球）；旁邊有小型成熟淋巴球、一個嗜中性球與一個粗顆粒嗜鹼性球作為大小對照。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and moderate pale-blue cytoplasm
Several cells show a small but visible central nucleolus (prolymphocytes)
Small mature lymphocyte with dense chromatin at the top center for size comparison
Segmented neutrophil and a basophil with coarse dark granules in the upper cluster
Background red cells with scattered platelets
62206.describe_en: The smear shows a population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with round nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, small central nucleoli in a subset, and moderate amounts of pale-blue cytoplasm, consistent with prolymphocytes, together with occasional small mature lymphocytes. A segmented neutrophil and a basophil are also present. No smudge cells are prominent in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes, supported by the case immunophenotype.

ddx.vs: B-PLL shows a predominance (>55%) of prolymphocytes with prominent nucleoli and a CD5-weak, CD23-negative, FMC7/CD20-bright phenotype, whereas this case is CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative.
Leukemic mantle cell lymphoma may contain nucleolated cells but is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and usually CD23-negative.
T-PLL cells have basophilic cytoplasmic blebs and irregular nuclei and express T-cell markers (CD3, CD7) with TCL1 rearrangement rather than CD19/CD20.

62078.recognize_zh: 這是 PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖（非形態圖）：最左為分子量標記，各樣本道都有一條共同的上方條帶（內部對照），部分樣本道另出現大小不同的下方條帶，代表偵測到特定 β 地中海貧血突變（如 ARMS-PCR 或 RFLP 檢測）。
features: Gel electrophoresis image of PCR products (non-morphologic)
Left lane: DNA size ladder with multiple reference bands
Six sample lanes each showing a shared upper band at similar size, consistent with an internal control amplicon
Lane 3 shows an additional low-molecular-weight band; lanes 5 and 6 show an additional intermediate-size band
Lanes 2, 4 and 7 show only the control band; rightmost lane is blank; residual material in wells
62078.describe_en: This is a gel electrophoresis image of PCR products rather than a morphologic image. A DNA size ladder is loaded in the first lane, and all six sample lanes contain a common upper band consistent with an internal control amplicon, confirming successful amplification. Lane 3 shows an additional small product and lanes 5 and 6 show an additional intermediate-size product, while the remaining lanes show only the control band. Without the lane key and primer design, the specific alleles cannot be assigned; in an allele-specific (ARMS) or restriction-digest assay for beta-thalassemia, the extra bands would indicate the presence of the tested mutations, and results must be correlated with the normal-allele reactions to determine zygosity.

ddx.vs: Primer-dimers run at very low molecular weight as diffuse smears and appear in negative controls, unlike discrete bands of expected size confined to specific samples.

ddx.dx: Gap-PCR for deletional alleles (e.g., Hb Lepore, alpha-globin deletions)
ddx.vs: Gap-PCR distinguishes alleles by amplicon size across deletion breakpoints, so interpretation depends on the assay design and lane legend rather than band presence alone.

62014.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中央的中性球核只有兩葉、以粗短橋相連，染色質粗塊狀（類 Pelger 樣雙葉核）；背景紅血球大小不一並有卵圓形大紅血球，是 MDS 常見的血液抹片表現。
features: Neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus connected by a thick chromatin bridge (pseudo-Pelger-Huet change)
Coarsely clumped nuclear chromatin
Cytoplasm with fine pink granules, only mildly reduced
Red cells show anisocytosis with macro-ovalocytes
Small platelet clump at lower edge
62014.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cell anisocytosis with macro-ovalocytes. A neutrophil has a bilobed nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin joined by a thick bridge, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huet change; cytoplasmic granulation is present but somewhat sparse. Platelets are present in small clumps and no blasts are seen. The findings are consistent with dysgranulopoiesis and macrocytosis, supporting a myelodysplastic neoplasm such as MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Inherited anomaly shows uniform bilobed neutrophils in nearly all cells with normal granulation and normal counts.
Megaloblastic anemia features hypersegmented (≥6 lobes) neutrophils rather than hyposegmented forms.
Bands have a continuous horseshoe-shaped nucleus of uniform width and less condensed chromatin, not two discrete dense lobes.

61950.recognize_zh: CD30染色只在散在的大型免疫母細胞呈膜狀及核旁點狀（Golgi）陽性，強度不一，背景小淋巴球為陰性；陽性細胞零散而非成片，是反應性活化免疫母細胞的表現。
features: Scattered large cells with membranous and paranuclear (Golgi-type) CD30 staining
Variable staining intensity among positive cells, from weak to strong
Positive cells are isolated rather than clustered or in sheets
Background small lymphocytes CD30-negative
61950.describe_en: CD30 immunostain shows scattered large cells with membranous and paranuclear dot-like staining of variable intensity, set in a background of negative small lymphocytes. The positive cells are dispersed individually and do not form clusters or sheets. This pattern is typical of activated immunoblasts in a reactive process such as EBV reactivation; CD30 positivity alone does not indicate lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HRS cells are CD30+ and CD15+ with weak PAX5 and loss of CD45/CD20, whereas reactive CD30+ immunoblasts are CD15- and CD45+ with strong lineage markers.
ALCL shows strong, uniform CD30 in cohesive sheets or sinusoidal clusters of hallmark cells, not scattered variable positivity.
EBV+ DLBCL can be CD30+ but shows sheets of large atypical B cells with architectural effacement.

61886.recognize_zh: MRI 矢狀切面顯示頸胸椎骨髓訊號斑駁、多處局灶異常（箭頭），全身核醫掃描可見肝脾與四肢長骨近端攝取；但骨髓切片只見富含三系造血、脂肪減少的增生骨髓而無腫瘤細胞，說明是斑塊狀造血（patchy hematopoiesis）造成的假轉移影像。
features: Sagittal spine MRI with heterogeneous, patchy vertebral marrow signal and focal abnormalities (red arrows)
Whole-body nuclear medicine scan with intense upper-abdominal (hepatosplenic) uptake and patchy uptake in the axial skeleton, shoulders, pelvis and long bones
Hypercellular marrow core with reduced fat
Trilineage hematopoiesis with erythroid islands, maturing granulocytes and megakaryocytes
No cohesive epithelial clusters, desmoplasia or monotonous neoplastic infiltrate
61886.describe_en: Composite figure. Sagittal MRI of the cervicothoracic spine (A) shows heterogeneous, patchy vertebral marrow signal with focal abnormalities (arrows) that raised concern for metastatic disease. The bone marrow biopsy (B) is hypercellular with decreased fat and shows orderly trilineage hematopoiesis, including erythroid islands, maturing myeloid elements and megakaryocytes, without cohesive tumor clusters, fibrosis or an abnormal lymphoid or plasma cell infiltrate. The whole-body scan (C; tracer not specified, pattern compatible with marrow scintigraphy) shows hepatosplenic uptake and patchy skeletal uptake including expansion into peripheral long bones. Findings are consistent with patchy hyperplastic (reactive) hematopoiesis mimicking bone metastases.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive keratin-positive epithelial clusters with desmoplastic stroma, whereas the biopsy shows only normal trilineage hematopoiesis.
Myeloma replaces the marrow with sheets of clonal plasma cells (CD138-positive, light-chain restricted), which are absent here.
MPNs show clustered, atypical megakaryocytes, reticulin fibrosis or panmyelosis with a driver mutation (JAK2, CALR, MPL), whereas this marrow shows orderly reactive hematopoiesis.
Lymphoma produces nodular, paratrabecular or interstitial aggregates of monotonous lymphoid cells confirmed by immunohistochemistry, not seen in this biopsy.

61822.recognize_zh: 巨核細胞標記免疫染色中，陽性巨核細胞體積偏小，核呈兩個或多個分離的小圓核或單一小核，零散分布於脂肪細胞之間，突顯小型、發育不良的巨核細胞。
features: Megakaryocyte-marker IHC with strong granular cytoplasmic brown staining
Positive megakaryocytes are small to medium sized
Nuclei hypolobated or in two or more separated small round nuclei
Megakaryocytes dispersed singly among adipocytes without tight clustering
Negative background hematopoietic cells; scattered brown-black hemosiderin pigment at top
61822.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for a megakaryocytic marker (likely CD61; marker not labeled) on the bone marrow core highlights scattered small-to-medium megakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei or two or more separated small round nuclei, lying singly among adipocytes without tight clusters. The background hematopoietic cells are negative, and coarse hemosiderin pigment is noted. The stain accentuates small dysplastic megakaryocytes that are easily underestimated on H&E. Findings support megakaryocytic dysplasia in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes are large with a single lobulated nucleus and are not frequently binucleated or small.
MPN megakaryocytes are enlarged, hyperlobated or bulbous and form tight paratrabecular or paravascular clusters.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters that are keratin-positive and CD61-negative.

61758.recognize_zh: lambda 原位雜交整個視野幾乎全為陰性，只有少數幾個細胞呈深藍色細胞質訊號；對照 kappa ISH 的大量陽性，呈 kappa 輕鏈限制，支持脾臟邊緣區淋巴瘤中單株漿細胞分化。
features: Only rare cells (about three to four in the field) show dark blue cytoplasmic lambda mRNA signal
The vast majority of plasma cells and lymphoid cells are lambda negative with pale red counterstain
Underlying tissue shows a diffuse infiltrate of small to medium cells in splenic parenchyma
Interpretation depends on comparison with the paired kappa ISH, which shows many positive cells
61758.describe_en: Lambda light-chain in situ hybridization shows only rare scattered positive cells, while the remainder of the cellular splenic infiltrate is negative. In comparison with the paired kappa ISH, which labels numerous plasma cells, the findings indicate kappa light-chain restriction. The rare lambda-positive cells likely represent residual polytypic plasma cells. Findings support a monotypic plasmacytic component in splenic marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: A reactive process would show lambda-positive cells in numbers roughly half those of kappa-positive cells rather than rare cells.

ddx.dx: Technical failure of the lambda probe
ddx.vs: Is excluded by the presence of rare crisply positive internal-control cells in this section.
Can show identical light-chain restriction, so separation relies on architecture, IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.

61694.recognize_zh: 400 倍骨髓切片 H&E 中，黃框內可見成群的巨大巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核呈過度分葉的鹿角狀（staghorn）而非怪異深染；成熟、大型、過度分葉的巨核細胞鬆散聚集，是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的典型表現。
features: Loose clusters of large to giant megakaryocytes (outlined in yellow)
Abundant mature eosinophilic cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei without marked hyperchromasia or bizarre cloud-like forms
Background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Scattered fat spaces; no obvious fibrosis visible on H&E
