61694.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows loose clusters of large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant mature cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, staghorn-like nuclei. The megakaryocytes lack the marked hyperchromasia, cloud-like nuclei, and dense clustering typical of primary myelofibrosis. The background shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements without apparent granulocytic proliferation. In the context of sustained thrombocytosis and a driver mutation, findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia; reticulin staining is needed to exclude fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Pre-PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei and dense clusters in a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size and elevated hemoglobin, rather than isolated giant hyperlobulated megakaryocytes.
Reactive states show normal-sized megakaryocytes without clustering or giant staghorn forms.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with SF3B1 and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T has ring sideroblasts and erythroid dysplasia with SF3B1 mutation.

61630.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中保有三系造血與脂肪，但可見一排排卵圓大核、泡狀染色質與明顯核仁的大型細胞，沿著竇狀血管呈線狀排列並有分裂相；這種「在血管腔內排隊」的大細胞分布是血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and fat
Large atypical cells with oval vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and pale cytoplasm
Linear, single-file arrangement of large cells within sinusoidal lumina
Mitotic figure among the intrasinusoidal large cells
Background erythroid precursors, maturing granulocytes and megakaryocytes without a mass-forming lesion
61630.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis. Scattered large atypical cells with oval vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm are aligned in a linear, single-file pattern within sinusoidal spaces, with a mitotic figure present. There is no discrete interstitial mass or paratrabecular aggregate. The subtle intrasinusoidal distribution of large atypical cells, confirmed by CD20 immunostaining, is consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: HSTCL also shows a sinusoidal pattern but the cells are small to medium with scant cytoplasm and are CD3+ CD20-, usually gamma-delta TCR.
Megakaryocytes are much larger with lobulated nuclei and abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, and erythroid precursors have round dense nuclei; neither align single-file in sinusoids.
Morphologically similar but CD3/CD56 and EBER positive and CD20 negative.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with desmoplasia and are keratin positive, CD45 negative.

61566.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一小群大型異常前骨髓球嵌在粉紅色顆粒性碎屑中，胞質顆粒極為粗密，箭頭所指細胞內可見多條 Auer 小體；雖然對焦欠佳，仍符合高顆粒型 APL。
features: Small cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with dense coarse azurophilic granulation
Arrowed cell with multiple Auer rods faintly visible within granular cytoplasm
One cell with folded/bilobed nucleus at left of cluster
Background of pink granular debris from ruptured cells and crenated red cells
Suboptimal focus and refractile artifact limit assessment of chromatin and nucleoli
61566.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes embedded in pink granular cellular debris. The cells have abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules, and the arrowed cell contains multiple Auer rods; one cell shows a folded, bilobed nucleus. Image focus is suboptimal and the surrounding red cells are crenated. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia, hypergranular type, pending genetic confirmation of PML::RARA.

ddx.vs: Blasts in AML with maturation carry a single fine Auer rod and are accompanied by maturing neutrophils rather than clusters of densely hypergranular promyelocytes with multiple rods.

ddx.dx: Toxic granulation in reactive left shift
ddx.vs: Reactive promyelocytes and myelocytes show coarse granules but lack Auer rods and show orderly maturation to segmented neutrophils.
Mast cells have round central nuclei and metachromatic purple-black granules without Auer rods, and are tryptase/CD117+ but MPO−.

61502.recognize_zh: 四格合成圖：A、B 周邊血液各見一個核質比高的淋巴球（A 較大、類似母細胞），C 為骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞塞滿大量細小的點狀胞內小體（Leishman-Donovan bodies，無鞭毛體），D 為富含細胞的骨髓切片；胞內滿佈小體的巨噬細胞是內臟利什曼病的關鍵。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood lymphoid cell with a high N:C ratio and moderately basophilic cytoplasm, blast-like at this resolution
Panel B: small mature-appearing lymphocyte with dense chromatin
Panel C: marrow macrophage packed with numerous small round intracellular bodies consistent with amastigotes
Panel D: hypercellular bone marrow biopsy with sheets of mixed hematopoietic and histiocytic cells
Low image resolution precludes visualization of the amastigote nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast
61502.describe_en: This composite figure shows peripheral blood smears (A-B), a bone marrow aspirate (C), and a bone marrow biopsy (D). The blood smears contain lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, one of which appears blast-like, but low resolution limits assessment of chromatin and nucleoli. The aspirate shows a macrophage distended by numerous small, round intracellular bodies, and the biopsy is hypercellular. Although the characteristic amastigote nucleus and kinetoplast cannot be resolved at this magnification, findings are suggestive of visceral leishmaniasis, to be confirmed by higher-power review, rK39 serology, culture, or PCR; the blast-like lymphocytes should not be mistaken for acute leukemia without flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts are slightly larger, have a clear halo, and lack a kinetoplast, and they are GMS and PAS positive, whereas Leishmania amastigotes are GMS negative.
T. cruzi amastigotes have a kinetoplast but are found in muscle or heart rather than marrow macrophages, and Toxoplasma lacks a kinetoplast.
HLH macrophages contain engulfed red cells, platelets, or nucleated cells rather than uniform small organisms.
True lymphoblasts are TdT+/CD34+ by flow cytometry and increased in the marrow, whereas reactive blast-like lymphocytes are mature and polyclonal.

61438.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆巨大的前紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast），胞質深藍、邊緣帶小突起，細胞核大而染色質呈均質淡染的玻璃樣外觀（核內病毒包涵體），像提燈般的「lantern cell」，提示微小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Giant pronormoblast, several times the size of surrounding cells, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a scalloped edge
Large round nucleus with pale, glassy, finely stippled chromatin (intranuclear viral inclusion) replacing normal chromatin detail
Nucleolus obscured; thin rim of darker cytoplasm around the nucleus
Surrounding smaller erythroid and myeloid precursors with coarse chromatin
Image is slightly oversaturated and out of focus, limiting fine chromatin assessment
61438.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant pronormoblast with intensely basophilic cytoplasm and a large nucleus containing pale, glassy chromatin consistent with an intranuclear viral inclusion. The surrounding marrow contains smaller hematopoietic precursors, and later-stage erythroid maturation is not prominent in this field. Image focus and color saturation limit detailed assessment. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation with parvovirus immunohistochemistry, serum PCR, and reticulocyte count is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows sheets of proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm and TP53 abnormalities rather than scattered giant cells with glassy nuclear inclusions.
Megaloblasts show open sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all erythroid stages, without glassy inclusions or erythroid aplasia.
Tumor cells are cohesive and megakaryoblasts have cytoplasmic blebs with CD61+, lacking an intranuclear viral inclusion.
Normal pronormoblasts are smaller with visible nucleoli and fine but not glassy chromatin.

61374.recognize_zh: 大型腫瘤細胞成片生長，核為泡狀並有明顯單一中央核仁，細胞質嗜雙色、部分呈漿細胞樣，並可見核分裂與凋亡碎片；右下插圖原位雜交顯示腫瘤細胞核強陽性（多為 EBER），符合漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large immunoblastic/plasmablastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with single prominent central nucleoli; some eccentric nuclei suggesting plasmacytic differentiation
Numerous mitoses including atypical forms, and apoptotic bodies
Scattered small lymphocytes and neutrophils; vague septa of pink stroma
Inset in situ hybridization: strong dark nuclear signal in most tumor cells (consistent with EBER positivity)
61374.describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of large neoplastic cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent central nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, some with eccentric nuclei suggesting plasmacytic differentiation. Mitotic activity, including atypical mitoses, and apoptosis are prominent. The inset in situ hybridization shows strong nuclear signal in the majority of tumor cells, consistent with EBV (EBER) positivity. Findings are consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma, which should show a plasma cell phenotype (CD138, MUM1, CD38) with loss of CD20 and PAX5 and a very high Ki-67 index.

ddx.vs: Morphology and phenotype overlap; myeloma is favored by a serum paraprotein, lytic bone lesions and marrow plasmacytosis, and is usually EBER negative.
Immunoblastic DLBCL retains CD20 and PAX5 expression, whereas plasmablastic lymphoma lacks mature B-cell markers.
Also CD20-negative with plasmablastic phenotype, but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK and is EBV negative.
Tumor cells are HHV8 (LANA-1) positive, often coinfected with EBV, and typically lack CD138-strong plasmacytic cytology.

61246.recognize_zh: 四格圖：淋巴結濾泡旁有壞死膿瘍區（A、C 大量中性球），血管周圍漿細胞浸潤（B），銀染色（D）可見黑色螺旋狀菌體（spirochetes），組合起來即為梅毒性淋巴結炎。
features: Panel A: lymph node with reactive follicle adjacent to a pale necrotic/suppurative zone and capsular hemorrhage
Panel B: perivascular and interstitial infiltrate rich in plasma cells within fibrotic stroma, with endothelial swelling
Panel C: abscess with sheets of neutrophils and nuclear debris; inset shows segmented neutrophils at high power
Panel D: silver stain (Warthin-Starry type) showing thin, black, tightly coiled spiral organisms among dark-stained cells; insets show individual spirochetes
61246.describe_en: Composite figure of a cervical lymph node. At low power (A) there is a reactive follicle bordering a zone of necrosis with suppuration and hemorrhage; the abscess (C) consists of sheets of neutrophils with karyorrhectic debris. Panel B shows a plasma cell-rich perivascular infiltrate in fibrotic stroma, a pattern associated with syphilitic vasculitis. A silver stain (D) demonstrates numerous thin, tightly coiled spirochetes (insets). Findings are consistent with syphilitic lymphadenitis with abscess formation; confirmation by Treponema pallidum immunohistochemistry, PCR or serology is appropriate.

ddx.vs: Stellate suppurative granulomas with palisading histiocytes are typical, and silver stain shows short pleomorphic bacilli rather than long coiled spirochetes.
Also shows stellate abscesses, but lacks demonstrable spirochetes and prominent plasma cell vasculitis; confirmed by Chlamydia trachomatis PCR.
Shows histiocyte-rich necrosis with karyorrhexis but characteristically lacks neutrophils, plasma cells and organisms.
Has plasma cell-rich infiltrates but no abscesses or spirochetes, and shows increased IgG4+ plasma cells.

61182.recognize_zh: 複合圖：B 格血液抹片為染色質呈塊狀「足球樣」（soccer ball）的小淋巴球（CLL）；E、F 格則出現大型細胞、細胞核中央有空洞或凹陷呈「甜甜圈」（donut）狀，流式顯示 kappa 單株限制，代表 Richter 轉化為大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel B: small mature lymphocytes with coarse, block-like clumped chromatin (soccer-ball pattern) and scant cytoplasm, typical of CLL
Panel E (H&E, high power): sheets of large cells, nuclei 3-4 times a small lymphocyte, with ring-shaped or doughnut nuclei showing central clearing/holes and conspicuous nucleoli
Panel F (smear): large atypical lymphoid cells with a central nuclear hole/inclusion and one with abundant cytoplasmic vacuoles
Panel A: dense diffuse infiltrate of intermediate to large lymphoid cells
Flow cytometry: CD5+ population with partial CD20 (49.1% CD20+) and kappa light chain restriction (99.6% kappa)
Panels G/H: strong membranous and cytoplasmic IHC staining in the large cell sheets (specific antigen not labeled)
61182.describe_en: This composite figure shows peripheral blood with small lymphocytes having coarsely clumped soccer-ball chromatin, consistent with the underlying chronic lymphocytic leukemia. Tissue sections and smears show a diffuse proliferation of large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli, and distinctive ring-shaped (doughnut) nuclei with central nuclear holes. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD5-positive B-cell population with partial CD20 expression and kappa light-chain restriction, and immunohistochemistry shows strong diffuse staining of the large cells (marker not labeled in the figure). Findings are consistent with Richter transformation of CLL to a diffuse large B-cell lymphoma with unusual doughnut-cell morphology; clonal relatedness requires IGHV comparison.

ddx.vs: Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a single central nucleolus and condensed chromatin but do not form sheets of large cells with ring-shaped nuclei.
Morphology is identical; IGHV rearrangement comparison with the CLL clone determines clonal relationship.
ALCL doughnut cells are T-cell/null, CD30 and often ALK positive and lack surface light-chain restriction, unlike this kappa-restricted B-cell process.
Hodgkin variant shows scattered CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background rather than confluent sheets of large B cells.

61118.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 皮膚切片：表皮大致正常，淺層真皮有一條相對少細胞的纖維帶（grenz zone 樣），其下真皮被致密、瀰漫至結節狀的淋巴細胞浸潤取代，屬「底部較重」的淋巴樣浸潤，提示 B 細胞淋巴瘤而非發炎性皮膚病。
features: Epidermis with mild acanthosis and orthokeratosis, without significant epidermotropism
Relatively uninvolved band of papillary/superficial dermis (grenz zone-like) with fibrosis and scattered cells
Dense, diffuse to vaguely nodular lymphoid infiltrate occupying the reticular dermis
Infiltrate composed of small cells with dark nuclei and plasmacytoid cells; detailed cytology limited at this magnification
Collagen bundles entrapped and separated by the infiltrate
61118.describe_en: Skin biopsy at low-to-medium power shows an unremarkable epidermis without epidermotropism, separated from the underlying infiltrate by a relatively spared, fibrotic superficial dermal band. The reticular dermis is replaced by a dense, diffuse to vaguely nodular lymphoid infiltrate that dissects collagen bundles. The cells appear small with dark nuclei, with admixed plasmacytoid forms, although detailed cytology is limited at this magnification. This bottom-heavy dermal infiltrate with a grenz zone favors a B-cell lymphoproliferative process and, with supporting immunophenotypic and light-chain studies, is consistent with extranodal marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Pseudolymphoma tends to be top-heavy with reactive germinal centers, tingible body macrophages and a polytypic plasma cell population.
MF shows epidermotropism with haloed atypical lymphocytes and Pautrier microabscesses, absent here.
PCFCL shows nodules or sheets of centrocytes and centroblasts that are BCL6 positive, without a prominent plasmacytic component.
CLL infiltrates are monotonous small round lymphocytes that are CD5 and CD23 positive, often perivascular and periadnexal.

60990.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片見一邊界清楚的結節，由互相吻合的血管腔構成，腔內襯高柱狀內皮細胞並含紅血球；結節內某個在周圍紅髓強陽性的標記呈陰性，而組織球標記（如 CD68/CD163 樣）瀰漫陽性，符合沿岸細胞血管瘤（littoral cell angioma）。
features: Low power: well-circumscribed, unencapsulated red-pulp nodule distinct from adjacent splenic parenchyma
Anastomosing vascular channels resembling splenic sinuses, containing red cells
Channels lined by plump, tall cuboidal-to-columnar endothelial cells, some sloughing into lumens, without significant atypia
IHC (panel B): marker strongly positive in surrounding normal sinus lining but largely lost within the nodule
IHC (panels E-F): lining cells positive for endothelial/histiocytic-type markers, with scattered positivity only in panel D
Specific antibodies are not labeled on the figure
60990.describe_en: Sections of spleen show a well-circumscribed nodule composed of anastomosing, sinus-like vascular channels filled with red cells and lined by plump, tall endothelial cells that focally slough into the lumens; there is no significant cytologic atypia or mitotic activity. Immunostains (antibodies not labeled in the figure) show loss within the nodule of a marker expressed by the surrounding sinus lining, with diffuse membranous/cytoplasmic positivity of the lining cells for other markers, consistent with the dual endothelial-histiocytic phenotype (e.g., CD31+, CD68/CD163+, CD8-, CD34-) characteristic of littoral cells. Findings are consistent with littoral cell angioma of the spleen.

ddx.vs: Lined by flat endothelial cells that are CD34/CD31-positive but lack histiocytic markers such as CD68 and CD163.
Composed of disorganized red pulp with CD8-positive sinus lining cells, whereas littoral cells are CD8-negative and histiocytic-marker positive.
Shows solid areas, marked nuclear atypia, mitoses, necrosis and infiltrative growth, which are absent here.
Multinodular angiomatoid nodules separated by fibrosclerotic stroma with mixed CD34+/CD31+/CD8+ vessel types, rather than uniform tall littoral-type lining.

60798.recognize_zh: 抹片中為中至大型、胞質深嗜鹼性的淋巴樣細胞，部分細胞形狀不規則帶胞質突起（A、B）；組織切片呈單一形態的中型細胞瀰漫片狀排列（C），膜狀 B 細胞標記陽性（D）且核染色幾乎全部陽性（E），型態介於 DLBCL 與 Burkitt 淋巴瘤之間，歸為高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤 NOS。
features: Panel A: medium to large lymphoid cells with dense chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm, one with a cytoplasmic fragment
Panel B: large irregular cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm and angular outlines on a blood/marrow smear
Panel C: diffuse sheet of monotonous medium-sized round cells with round nuclei and scant to moderate cytoplasm
Panel D: membranous staining of the neoplastic cells with a B-cell/surface marker
Panel E: nuclear staining in nearly all tumor cells, indicating a very high proliferation index or strong MYC expression (antibody not labeled)
60798.describe_en: Smear preparations (A, B) show medium to large atypical lymphoid cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and irregular cytoplasmic contours. The tissue section (C) shows a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized cells with round nuclei. Immunohistochemistry shows membranous positivity (D) and nuclear positivity in nearly all tumor cells (E); the antibodies are not identified in the figure. The morphology and phenotype are intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and Burkitt lymphoma, suggestive of high-grade B-cell lymphoma, NOS, provided MYC/BCL2 rearrangement status excludes double-hit lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Shows strictly monomorphic medium cells with starry-sky pattern, CD10+/BCL2-negative, Ki-67 near 100% and isolated MYC rearrangement without a complex karyotype.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: May look identical; separated only by FISH demonstrating concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.
Cells are larger and more pleomorphic (centroblasts/immunoblasts) with a lower, more variable proliferation index.
Blasts have fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm and express TdT/CD34, lacking surface immunoglobulin.

60606.recognize_zh: 背景中散布大量大小不一、淡灰藍色、無細胞核的小圓形胞質碎片（淋巴腺小體，lymphoglandular bodies），加上下方成群的大型異常淋巴球，提示抽吸液被侵襲性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤浸潤。
features: Numerous small, round, pale gray-blue anucleate cytoplasmic fragments (lymphoglandular bodies) scattered in the background
Clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, round to irregular nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Some large cells with cytoplasmic vacuoles; admixed necrotic/degenerating cells
Residual normal hematopoietic cells (segmented neutrophil, erythroid precursors) scattered
Background proteinaceous material with red cells
60606.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a background containing abundant small, round, pale basophilic cytoplasmic fragments without nuclei, consistent with lymphoglandular bodies. There are clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and deeply basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm, with scattered residual hematopoietic elements. Lymphoglandular bodies are a cytologic clue to a lymphoid process shed from fragile cells. Findings are suggestive of marrow involvement by an aggressive large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and biopsy immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Platelets are smaller with purple granular centers, whereas lymphoglandular bodies are pale gray-blue and agranular.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or small round blue cell tumor
ddx.vs: Non-lymphoid tumors form cohesive clusters and lack lymphoglandular bodies in the background.
Myeloblasts show fine chromatin, possible Auer rods and granules and do not generate a lymphoglandular body background; flow cytometry confirms lineage.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with uniform vacuolated deep blue cytoplasm, and MYC rearrangement with high Ki-67 is needed to separate it from large B-cell lymphoma.

60670.recognize_zh: 血性腦脊髓液（CSF）細胞離心抹片中可見數團黏附成片的細胞，核圓形、大小一致、染色質細緻、胞質豐富淡紫藍色且界線模糊，呈蜂巢狀排列，屬於良性室管膜（ependymal）細胞，背景大量紅血球提示穿刺創傷。
features: Cohesive sheets and clusters of cells with abundant pale lavender cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Round to oval, uniform, centrally placed nuclei with finely granular chromatin
Low N:C ratio; no prominent nucleoli, mitoses, or nuclear molding
Flat, monolayer honeycomb-like arrangement without three-dimensional clustering
Heavily bloody background with numerous red cells and few scattered leukocytes
60670.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows a markedly bloody background containing several cohesive, flat sheets of cells. The cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with ill-defined borders and uniform round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. There is no significant nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, molding, or mitotic activity. Findings are consistent with benign ependymal/choroid plexus lining cells, most likely introduced by a traumatic tap, and should not be interpreted as metastatic carcinoma or leukemic involvement.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form three-dimensional clusters with nuclear enlargement, pleomorphism, hyperchromasia, and prominent nucleoli, unlike these bland, uniform monolayer sheets.
Choroid plexus cells are closely related and also benign, often forming papillary clusters with more granular cytoplasm; both are clinically insignificant contaminants.

ddx.dx: Leukemic or lymphoma involvement of CSF
ddx.vs: Leukemic cells are discohesive, single cells with high N:C ratio rather than cohesive sheets with abundant cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Germinal matrix cells in neonatal CSF
ddx.vs: Germinal matrix cells are small, dark, blast-like cells with scant cytoplasm in tight clusters, whereas these cells have abundant cytoplasm and bland round nuclei.

60734.recognize_zh: 周邊血出現大型、細胞質深嗜鹼性且邊緣不規則、核形扭曲的非典型細胞，骨髓切片散在大型多形細胞，CD30 呈膜狀加核旁點狀（Golgi）強陽性，提示循環中的 CD30 陽性退行性（anaplastic）T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Peripheral blood (A–D): large atypical cells with deeply basophilic, irregular cytoplasm and angular or tapering cytoplasmic projections
Nuclei irregular, folded or reniform with moderately condensed chromatin; one cell (D) with dense coarse chromatin and a narrow blue cytoplasmic rim
Bone marrow biopsy (E–G): scattered large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm and vesicular, irregular nuclei among hematopoietic elements
IHC (H): strong membranous and paranuclear dot-like (Golgi) CD30 staining of the large cells
60734.describe_en: The peripheral blood smear contains large atypical mononuclear cells with deeply basophilic, irregularly contoured cytoplasm, cytoplasmic projections and irregular or folded nuclei. The bone marrow core biopsy shows interstitially scattered large pleomorphic cells with vesicular nuclei admixed with residual trilineage hematopoiesis. By immunohistochemistry, the large cells show strong membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 expression. Findings are consistent with marrow and peripheral blood involvement by a CD30-positive T-cell lymphoma with anaplastic morphology; ALK status and T-cell lineage should be confirmed by flow cytometry and immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive immunoblasts are round with a single central nucleolus, are polyclonal and at most weakly CD30+, unlike these angulated pleomorphic cells with strong Golgi CD30.
Monoblasts have fine lacy chromatin, gray-blue cytoplasm and are CD30-negative but CD14/CD64/lysozyme positive.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5 weak and sit in a fibrotic mixed inflammatory background, and do not circulate in blood.
ATLL cells are flower cells with multilobated nuclei, are CD25-bright and HTLV-1 related, and are usually CD30-negative or only partially positive.

captions: Peripheral blood: large atypical cell with basophilic, angular cytoplasm
Peripheral blood: elongated atypical cell with irregular nucleus
Peripheral blood: atypical cell with cytoplasmic projections
Peripheral blood: atypical cell with dense chromatin and blue cytoplasmic rim
Bone marrow biopsy: scattered large pleomorphic cells
Bone marrow biopsy: large atypical cells among hematopoietic elements
Bone marrow biopsy: large cells with vesicular irregular nuclei
CD30 IHC: membranous and Golgi-pattern positivity in large cells

60542.recognize_zh: CD123 免疫染色下，成群、片狀聚集的中型細胞呈強烈膜性與細胞質陽性，與周圍未染色的背景細胞形成清楚分區，符合漿細胞樣樹突細胞（plasmacytoid dendritic cells）結節性聚集。
features: Large confluent aggregates of CD123-positive cells separated by negative areas
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic brown staining in medium-sized cells
Positive cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with scant to moderate cytoplasm
Some elongated/spindled positive cells, possibly endothelial staining (CD123 also marks endothelium)
Background small round cells are CD123-negative
60542.describe_en: CD123 immunohistochemical stain highlights large nodular and sheet-like clusters of medium-sized cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity, separated by areas of CD123-negative small cells. Scattered elongated positive profiles likely represent endothelial staining. The staining pattern is consistent with nodular aggregates of plasmacytoid dendritic cells; distinguishing a reactive/MPN- or CMML-associated mature PDC proliferation from blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm requires correlation with morphology and additional markers (CD4, CD56, TCF4, TCL1, CD34, TdT).

ddx.vs: BPDCN shows diffuse infiltration by blast-like cells co-expressing CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1, whereas mature PDC nodules are cohesive clusters usually lacking CD56 and associated with a myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML may express CD123 and CD4 but is lysozyme/CD14/CD163 positive and lacks the TCF4/TCL1 PDC profile.
Benign lymphoid aggregates are composed of CD3/CD20-positive small lymphocytes and are CD123-negative apart from scattered PDCs.

60478.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中央有一顆中等大小淋巴球，核圓偏心、染色質較疏，細胞質淡藍灰色且邊緣呈不規則毛狀突起（hairy projections），可與左側一般淋巴球及右側嗜中性球比較。
features: Medium-sized mononuclear cell, larger than the adjacent small lymphocyte
Round to slightly oval eccentric nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin, no prominent nucleolus
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with irregular, frayed circumferential projections
Adjacent small lymphocyte and segmented neutrophil for size comparison
Background red cells largely unremarkable; platelets present
60478.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating atypical lymphoid cell of medium size with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine irregular cytoplasmic projections. A normal-appearing small lymphocyte and a segmented neutrophil are present for comparison. Red cells show no significant abnormality in this field. Findings are consistent with circulating hairy cells; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi, more basophilic scant cytoplasm, and often a visible nucleolus, and are CD103/CD25 negative.
HCL-v cells show a prominent central nucleolus like prolymphocytes and are CD25 and annexin A1 negative with leukocytosis.
Monocytes have folded nuclei, lacier chromatin, gray cytoplasm with vacuoles and fine granules rather than circumferential hair-like projections.

60350.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中一小群大型母細胞，細胞質中等量、灰藍色並散佈細小嗜天青顆粒，核圓或輕微凹陷、染色質細緻並見核仁，呈單核球系母細胞（monoblast/promonocyte）樣，符合 AML with t(9;11) 常見的單核球分化。
features: Cluster of large blasts with moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm
Fine azurophilic granules scattered in the cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Round to slightly indented or notched nuclei with fine, lacy chromatin and visible nucleoli
One cell with a folded/bilobed nucleus and pinkish granular cytoplasm, likely a maturing myelomonocytic cell
Background red cells without specific abnormality
60350.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with moderate amounts of gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. The nuclei are round to slightly indented with finely dispersed chromatin and one or more nucleoli, and one adjacent cell has a folded nucleus with pinkish granular cytoplasm consistent with a maturing myelomonocytic element. No Auer rods are identified. The monocytoid blast morphology is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, which in this case carries t(9;11)(p22;q23); KMT2A-MLLT3; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry help confirm the monocytic lineage.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have less abundant, less gray cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods, and are nonspecific esterase-negative with a maturing neutrophil series.
Promyelocytes in APL are packed with coarse granules, may have multiple Auer rods (faggot cells) and bilobed nuclei, and are CD34-/HLA-DR-.
Mature monocytes have condensed, folded chromatin without nucleoli and vacuolated cytoplasm, and blasts are not increased.

60222.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示伸出的舌頭表面光滑、泛紅且有明顯溝裂，舌乳頭變平（萎縮性舌炎 atrophic glossitis），為缺鐵的非血液學表現之一；本張照片看不到匙狀指甲或口角炎。
features: Clinical photograph of a protruded tongue
Smooth, glossy, erythematous (beefy) dorsal surface with loss of filiform papillae
Prominent fissures and furrows on the dorsum
Angular cheilitis and koilonychia are not visible in this photograph
60222.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a protruded tongue with a smooth, shiny, erythematous surface and apparent loss of papillae, accompanied by deep fissures. The oral commissures are not well demonstrated, and no angular cheilitis is evident; the nails are not shown. Findings are consistent with atrophic glossitis, a recognized epithelial manifestation of iron deficiency, although the appearance is not specific.

ddx.dx: Vitamin B12 or folate deficiency glossitis (Hunter glossitis)
ddx.vs: Appearance is clinically indistinguishable, so serum B12/folate levels and red cell indices (macrocytosis) are needed.
Shows migrating, well-demarcated red patches with white serpiginous borders rather than diffuse papillary atrophy.
Fissures occur with preserved papillae and normal color, without diffuse smooth atrophy.

60158.recognize_zh: 切片以疏鬆、纖維狀的基質為主，細胞核拉長並朝同一方向排列成「流線狀」，下方有數顆細胞核深染、呈團塊狀的非典型巨核細胞沿纖維方向排列，右側可見擴張的竇狀空腔，符合骨髓纖維化期。
features: Loose fibrillary to edematous stroma with markedly reduced hematopoietic cellularity in this area
Streaming of elongated, spindled nuclei and hematopoietic cells aligned in one direction
Atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, clumped, irregular nuclei, some in a small aligned cluster
Scattered residual erythroid precursors and granulocytes; small aggregate of dark erythroid nuclei at upper left
Dilated sinusoidal space at right edge
60158.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section shows extensive replacement of the hematopoietic space by loose fibrillary stroma with a streaming pattern of spindled cells. Residual hematopoiesis is patchy and includes small erythroid clusters and granulocytes. Megakaryocytes are atypical, with hyperchromatic, clumped and irregular nuclei, and are aligned along the fibrous stroma; a dilated sinus is present. Findings are consistent with advanced marrow fibrosis, in keeping with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis given the history of polycythemia vera; reticulin and trichrome stains should be used to grade fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Histologically indistinguishable; the diagnosis of post-PV myelofibrosis requires a prior documented PV phase.
MDS with fibrosis has small hypolobated/separated-lobe dysplastic megakaryocytes and lineage dysplasia on the aspirate rather than the bulbous hyperchromatic MPN-type megakaryocytes.
Post-chemotherapy serous or edematous change shows hypocellularity without clusters of atypical megakaryocytes or streaming fibrosis on reticulin stain.
Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clusters positive for keratin or other lineage markers, unlike megakaryocytes which are CD61-positive and dispersed.

60094.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型芽細胞，核呈摺疊或凹陷、染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質中等量灰藍色並帶細小顆粒與空泡，部分帶單核球樣核形；芽細胞增多（44%），在化療後病人要考慮治療相關 AML。
features: Large blasts with moderate N:C ratio
Nuclei irregular, folded or indented (monocytoid), with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles
Occasional cell with a lobulated/cleaved nucleus suggestive of promonocytic differentiation
Scattered small red cell fragments and platelet debris in the background
60094.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large blasts with moderate N:C ratio, irregular to folded nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli. The cytoplasm is moderate in amount, gray-blue, and contains fine azurophilic granules and small vacuoles, with some cells showing monocytoid nuclear folding. Auer rods are not identified in this field. Blasts constitute 44% of the aspirate differential; in the setting of prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are consistent with therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia, possibly with myelomonocytic features.

ddx.dx: AML with KMT2A rearrangement (topoisomerase II inhibitor-related)
ddx.vs: Monocytoid blasts after topoisomerase II inhibitors suggest KMT2A (11q23) rearrangement, which must be shown by cytogenetics/FISH.
APL variant shows bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with strong MPO and PML::RARA, and often DIC; confirm by FISH or PCR.
CMML has fewer than 20% blasts plus promonocytes with persistent monocytosis, whereas 44% blasts here meets AML.

30974.recognize_zh: A 列為高度細胞化骨髓中的小型、核低分葉的「侏儒」巨核細胞（dwarf megakaryocytes），典型 CML；B 列在 imatinib 治療後變成大型、核高度分葉如鹿角狀（staghorn）的巨核細胞，位於脂肪較多的骨髓，呈 ET 樣形態，反映共存的 JAK2 V617F 克隆。
features: Panel A: small megakaryocytes with round to hypolobated nuclei (dwarf megakaryocytes) in a hypercellular granulocyte-rich marrow
Panel B: large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply hyperlobated, staghorn-like nuclei
Panel B megakaryocytes lie loosely adjacent to fat spaces with more normocellular surrounding marrow
Panel A background: sheets of maturing myeloid cells and small dark nuclei, consistent with myeloid hyperplasia
30974.describe_en: Composite bone marrow biopsy sections (H&E). Pre-treatment sections (A) show a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic hyperplasia and small megakaryocytes with hypolobated nuclei, typical of the dwarf megakaryocytes of chronic myeloid leukemia. Post-imatinib sections (B) show large megakaryocytes with abundant cytoplasm and hyperlobulated staghorn-like nuclei in a less cellular marrow, resembling essential thrombocythemia. Findings are consistent with suppression of the BCR-ABL1 clone by imatinib unmasking a coexistent JAK2 V617F-driven ET-like megakaryocytic proliferation.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei forming dense clusters, often with reticulin fibrosis, rather than mature staghorn forms.
MDS micromegakaryocytes are smaller with a single round nucleus and accompany dysplasia in other lineages without BCR-ABL1 or JAK2-driven myeloproliferation.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but normal in size and lobulation, without giant staghorn forms and without a clonal driver mutation.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes and erythroid hyperplasia with elevated hemoglobin, whereas ET-like marrow has megakaryocytic proliferation alone.

27902.recognize_zh: 一個大型巨核細胞的淡紫色顆粒胞質上，疊著兩個圓形深染的細胞核（像眼睛）與一個馬蹄形的帶狀核嗜中性球（像笑嘴），構成「笑臉」，這是細胞穿行於巨核細胞胞質內的 emperipolesis 或單純重疊，而非吞噬。
features: Very large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular pale lilac cytoplasm occupying most of the field
Two round dense nuclei of small hematopoietic cells and a horseshoe-shaped band neutrophil nucleus lying within/over the megakaryocyte cytoplasm, forming a smiley-face configuration
Engulfed cells appear intact without surrounding digestion vacuoles, consistent with emperipolesis
Megakaryocyte nucleus faintly visible in the upper cytoplasm; adjacent dense multilobated nuclear mass of a second megakaryocyte or overlapping cells at right
Background of hypercellular marrow with granulocytic precursors and neutrophils
27902.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm within which two small round dense nuclei and a band neutrophil are positioned, producing a 'smiley face' appearance. The internalized cells appear intact without phagocytic vacuoles, consistent with emperipolesis rather than phagocytosis. The surrounding marrow is cellular with maturing granulocytic elements. This is an incidental, benign morphologic curiosity; emperipolesis may be increased in reactive states and in myeloproliferative neoplasms, but is not diagnostic on its own.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have a single oval nucleus and vacuolated cytoplasm with degraded engulfed cells, whereas megakaryocytes have granular cytoplasm, a lobulated nucleus and intact internalized cells.
Superimposed cells lie in a different focal plane and may extend beyond the cytoplasmic border, while true emperipolesis shows cells within a clear halo inside the cytoplasm.
In RDD, lymphocytes and plasma cells are engulfed by large S100-positive histiocytes in lymph nodes, not by marrow megakaryocytes.

19710.recognize_zh: 腦部 MRI（A）有多發 T2 高訊號病灶，腦組織切片（B）可見致密的漿細胞樣浸潤緊鄰腦實質，腦脊髓液抹片（C）可見核偏心、細胞質深藍且有核周淡染區的漿細胞（含雙核型），符合漿細胞腫瘤侵犯腦實質與腦脊髓液。
features: Brain MRI (T2-weighted) with multiple bilateral hyperintense cortical/subcortical lesions (panel A)
Brain tissue with a dense sheet-like infiltrate of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei beneath gliotic eosinophilic parenchyma (panel B)
CSF cytospin with atypical plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (panel C)
One binucleated plasma cell and cells with perinuclear hof in the CSF
No inflammatory background of neutrophils or small reactive lymphocytes in the CSF field
19710.describe_en: Brain MRI shows multiple bilateral T2-hyperintense parenchymal lesions. The brain biopsy shows a dense, sheet-like infiltrate of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm infiltrating beneath gliotic parenchyma. The CSF cytospin contains atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and occasional binucleation, without a reactive inflammatory background. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by a plasma cell neoplasm (reported IgA-lambda plasma cell myeloma with parenchymal and leptomeningeal/CSF disease); confirmation with CD138 and lambda light chain restriction by IHC or flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Bing-Neel shows a mixture of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes, and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population with IgA-lambda.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis in CNS infection or inflammation
ddx.vs: Reactive CSF plasma cells are mature, sparse, and admixed with lymphocytes and monocytes, and are polytypic for kappa and lambda.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or DLBCL with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: These show larger cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, a high Ki-67, and often EBV/MYC positivity, without a history of myeloma.

19390.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，以核深染的小淋巴球為主，並散布大量破碎的污斑細胞（smudge cells），其間夾雜細胞質較多、核較大的中大型淋巴樣細胞，大小不一，符合 CLL 混合細胞型。
features: Marked lymphocytosis with nucleated cells scattered throughout the field at low power
Predominant small lymphocytes with dense dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Numerous smudge cells with pale, disrupted chromatin
Admixed medium-to-large lymphoid cells with more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin
Occasional mature neutrophil; red cells normocytic with rouleaux-like overlap and drying artifact
19390.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by numerous smudge cells. A distinct subset of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with more abundant pale-blue cytoplasm and less condensed chromatin is admixed, producing a heterogeneous appearance; nucleoli cannot be assessed reliably at this magnification. Occasional neutrophils are present and red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia of mixed cell type; higher-power review to quantify prolymphocytes and flow cytometric confirmation with exclusion of mantle cell lymphoma are recommended.

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma shows fewer smudge cells and more irregular nuclei and is cyclin D1-positive, CD23-negative, and CD200-negative with t(11;14).
Prolymphocytic leukemia has more than 55% nucleolated prolymphocytes, whereas small mature lymphocytes and smudge cells dominate here.
Reactive lymphocytosis is polymorphous with abundant cytoplasm, lacks the large number of smudge cells, and is polytypic by flow cytometry.

17022.recognize_zh: 兩顆小至中型單核白血球（形似淋巴球）的細胞質內有粗大、深紫紅色顆粒，下方細胞顆粒尤其明顯且散布於核周與細胞質邊緣，符合 Alder-Reilly 異常（常見於黏多醣症）的異常粗大顆粒。
features: Two small-to-medium mononuclear leukocytes, lymphocyte-sized, with round nuclei and high N:C ratio
Coarse, dark purple-red cytoplasmic granules, most prominent in the lower cell and overlapping the nucleus
Upper cell shows fewer coarse granules in a thin rim of cytoplasm
Granules are larger and darker than normal azurophilic granules of large granular lymphocytes
Faded, pink-toned staining and limited resolution restrict assessment of chromatin and granule detail
17022.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two lymphocyte-sized mononuclear cells containing coarse, dark purple-red cytoplasmic granules, most conspicuous in the lower cell where granules surround and overlie the nucleus. The granules are larger and darker than normal azurophilic granules. Red cells are unremarkable. The staining is faded and resolution is limited, so granulocytes should be examined for similar inclusions. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly anomaly, which reflects accumulated mucopolysaccharide and should prompt evaluation for a mucopolysaccharidosis.

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation affects neutrophils in infection with fine-to-coarse granules accompanied by Dohle bodies and vacuoles, and is transient rather than involving lymphocytes.
Basophils have a segmented nucleus obscured by large, water-soluble dark blue-black granules, whereas these cells have round nuclei.
Chediak-Higashi shows fewer, giant fused granules in granulocytes and lymphocytes rather than many uniformly coarse granules.
LGLs have more abundant pale cytoplasm with a few fine azurophilic granules, not dense coarse dark granules.

15166.recognize_zh: 單一中小型淋巴細胞，細胞核圓、染色質細緻，周圍一圈淡藍灰色細胞質向外伸出許多細長毛髮狀突起（hairy projections），是毛細胞白血病（hairy cell leukemia）的典型毛細胞。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cell, about 1.5-2 times the diameter of a red cell
Round, centrally placed nucleus with moderately condensed, stippled chromatin and no prominent nucleolus
Moderate amount of pale blue-gray cytoplasm
Circumferential fine, hair-like cytoplasmic projections
Background red cells unremarkable apart from mild drying artifact
15166.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a medium-sized lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, finely clumped chromatin without a conspicuous nucleolus, and a moderate rim of pale blue-gray cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic border bears numerous fine, circumferential hair-like projections. The surrounding red cells show no specific abnormality. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell of hairy cell leukemia; confirmation by flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123 positive) and/or BRAF V600E testing is recommended.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent central nucleolus, higher WBC without monocytopenia, and are CD25-negative and BRAF V600E wild-type.
SMZL villous lymphocytes show short, polar (bipolar) villi rather than fine circumferential projections and lack CD103/CD25/annexin A1.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based, unevenly distributed villi and are usually CD25- and annexin A1-negative.

ddx.dx: Monocyte or reactive lymphocyte with drying artifact
ddx.vs: Monocytes have folded nuclei with gray vacuolated cytoplasm, and artifactual cytoplasmic fraying is irregular rather than evenly distributed fine hairs.

13502.recognize_zh: H&E 下骨髓腔以纖維基質為主，可見平行排列的紡錘狀核，中上方有一個核深染、不規則多葉的小至中型異常巨核細胞，右側與下方擴張竇腔內有紅血球與有核細胞；造血細胞稀少、纖維化伴異型巨核細胞，符合原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期。
features: Fibrous stroma with streaming, elongated spindle nuclei replacing hematopoietic tissue
Atypical megakaryocyte with hyperchromatic, irregular, clumped nucleus in the upper center
Dilated sinusoids containing red cells and small dark nucleated cells, suggestive of intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis
Scattered small dense nuclei of residual hematopoietic cells in a loose myxoid-to-fibrillar background
Edge of a bony trabecula at upper left; fine detail limited by image quality
13502.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows marked stromal fibrosis with streaming spindle-shaped nuclei and sparse residual hematopoiesis. An atypical megakaryocyte with a hyperchromatic, irregularly clumped nucleus is present, and dilated sinusoids contain red cells and nucleated hematopoietic cells. Image resolution limits fine nuclear assessment. Findings are consistent with the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; fibrosis grading with reticulin and trichrome stains and correlation with driver mutation status are recommended.

ddx.vs: MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated or monolobated megakaryocytes and dysplasia in other lineages rather than hyperchromatic cloud-like forms.
Metastases contain cohesive keratin-positive epithelial cells rather than isolated megakaryocytes in the fibrosis.
Histology is indistinguishable and requires documented prior MPN history.

3454.recognize_zh: 抹片中央一顆大型組織球，胞質淡灰藍、充滿小空泡，並含多個深藍到灰黑色團塊狀碎屑與一個含淡染物質的大空泡，核偏一側；周邊為紅血球，符合吞噬碎屑的組織球（debris-laden histiocyte）。
features: Large histiocyte with abundant pale gray-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm and irregular cell border
Multiple coarse dark blue to gray-black cytoplasmic clumps of phagocytosed debris
One large clear phagocytic vacuole containing pale fragmented material
Single oval nucleus with finely reticular chromatin and no prominent nucleolus
Background of intact erythrocytes with rouleaux-like stacking
3454.describe_en: Smear shows a large histiocyte with abundant finely vacuolated pale gray-blue cytoplasm and an oval nucleus with fine chromatin. The cytoplasm contains multiple coarse dark blue to gray-black clumps and a large clear vacuole with pale fragmented material, consistent with phagocytosed cellular debris. No intact ingested erythrocytes, nucleated cells or microorganisms are identified. Findings are consistent with a debris-laden histiocyte, a nonspecific reactive finding indicating increased cell turnover or clearance of apoptotic material.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytes contain recognizable intact red cells, platelets or nucleated cells rather than amorphous debris.
Sea-blue histiocytes show numerous uniform sea-blue ceroid granules rather than a few coarse dark clumps and vacuoles.
Histoplasma yeasts are uniform 2-4 um oval bodies with a clear halo and eccentric chromatin dot, unlike irregular debris.

1790.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆大型組織球，細胞質淡藍、呈皺褶紙巾或纖維狀條紋（wrinkled tissue paper / crumpled silk），內含偏心小核，周圍是正常骨髓造血細胞，這就是 Gaucher 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Large histiocyte many times the diameter of surrounding myeloid precursors
Abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture
Small, eccentric, round-to-oval nuclei (two nuclear profiles within the cell) with moderately condensed chromatin
No cytoplasmic vacuoles or foamy lipid droplets
Background of granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes/myelocytes, band neutrophil) and erythroid cells
1790.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage among maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors. The cell has abundant pale blue, fibrillary cytoplasm with a striated 'crumpled tissue paper' appearance and small eccentric nuclei. The cytoplasm is not vacuolated or foamy. Findings are consistent with a Gaucher cell, supportive of Gaucher disease; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA gene testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look nearly identical by light microscopy, so the distinction requires clinical context, the underlying neoplasm or infection, and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly 'soap-bubble' cytoplasm rather than the striated tissue-paper cytoplasm seen here.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules on Wright-Giemsa rather than fibrillary striations.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and finely granular pink cytoplasm, not small eccentric nuclei within striated pale cytoplasm.

1406.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球像一疊硬幣般串連成長鏈（rouleaux），在紅血球本來應分開的薄區仍成串出現，提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白，符合多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Red cells stacked in long, linear chains resembling stacks of coins (rouleaux)
Rouleaux present in a thin area where red cells should lie separately
Individual red cells normocytic with central pallor where not stacked
Occasional small platelets in the background; no leukocytes in this field
1406.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows prominent rouleaux formation, with red cells arranged in linear, coin-stack chains that persist in the thin monolayer portion of the smear. Unstacked red cells are normocytic with preserved central pallor. Few platelets are seen, and no leukocytes are present in this high-power field. Findings suggest increased plasma proteins, such as a monoclonal immunoglobulin, and are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm in the appropriate clinical setting; serum protein electrophoresis with immunofixation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates are irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than orderly linear stacks, and they may disperse on warming.
Overlapping red cells in the thick part of a smear are random and disappear in the monolayer, whereas true rouleaux persist in the thin area.
Morphology cannot separate them; SPE/immunofixation shows a broad polyclonal increase or acute-phase pattern rather than a monoclonal spike.

1278.recognize_zh: 抽吸液中可見大量核圓、染色質細緻、胞質藍的母細胞，與各階段成熟中的顆粒球混雜；這個視野能看出母細胞增加，但巨核細胞只在邊角出現、看不清型態，單靠此圖無法指出 inv(3) 特有的低分葉巨核細胞。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with increased intermediate to large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and moderately basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed maturing granulocytes: promyelocytes, myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Scattered small lymphocytes and occasional erythroid precursors
Edge of a marrow particle with fat space at lower left
Megakaryocytes only partially captured at the field edge, too limited to assess lobation
1278.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with an increased population of intermediate to large blasts showing round nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderately basophilic cytoplasm. These are admixed with maturing granulocytic elements at all stages, scattered lymphocytes and occasional erythroid precursors, adjacent to a particle edge. Megakaryocytes are not well represented in this field, so the hypolobated megakaryocytes typical of MECOM-rearranged AML cannot be evaluated here. The findings support acute myeloid leukemia; assignment to AML with inv(3)(q21.3q26.2) or t(3;3) requires cytogenetic or FISH confirmation.

ddx.vs: Shows the same blasts with maturing granulocytes, and is excluded only when karyotype shows no defining abnormality such as inv(3)/t(3;3).
Requires multilineage dysplasia or MDS-related cytogenetics, and MECOM rearrangement takes diagnostic precedence.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: Also shows blasts with maturing granulocytes plus basophilia, but is defined by BCR::ABL1, which can coexist with inv(3) as secondary progression.

1086.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片網狀纖維染色（reticulin）中，黑色纖維明顯增粗、交錯成網並呈平行流線狀，間有小型核分葉少的巨核細胞；代表 CML 伴隨骨髓纖維化。
features: Silver-impregnated reticulin fibers markedly increased in density
Diffuse, intersecting network of fibers with areas of parallel streaming
Scattered megakaryocytes, some small with hypolobated nuclei, entrapped in the fiber network
Hypercellular marrow with no visible fat in this field
Estimated grade MF-2 to MF-3 (no collagen assessment possible on this stain)
1086.describe_en: Reticulin stain of a hypercellular bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse and dense increase in reticulin fibers forming an extensive intersecting network with focal parallel streaming. Scattered megakaryocytes, including small hypolobated forms, are entrapped within the fibrosis. The fiber density corresponds to at least grade MF-2 by the European consensus scheme; a trichrome stain is needed to assess collagen. In a patient with CML, marrow fibrosis of this degree is an adverse feature that may accompany disease progression.

ddx.vs: PMF has clustered, bulbous 'cloud-like' megakaryocytes and is BCR::ABL1 negative with JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.

ddx.dx: Acute panmyelosis with myelofibrosis / AML with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34+ blasts on IHC in a fibrotic marrow rather than a chronic-phase maturing granulocytic proliferation.
Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin positive, visible on H&E and IHC.

1150.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片可見混合性浸潤，含多量活化的大型細胞（免疫母細胞）、上皮樣組織球、小淋巴球與顯著的高內皮小靜脈；此視野未見壞死或病毒包涵體，為非特異的濾泡間/副皮質區反應，需與其他視野合看。
features: Mixed polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, and scattered larger activated cells
Large immunoblast-like cells with vesicular nuclei and single visible nucleoli
Clusters of histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Prominent vessels with plump endothelium (high endothelial venules)
No necrosis or definite viral inclusions in this field
1150.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a polymorphous paracortical infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells, histiocytes, and scattered large activated immunoblast-like cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli. Vessels with plump endothelial cells are prominent. Necrosis and definite herpetic intranuclear inclusions are not identified in this field. Findings are those of a reactive paracortical/immunoblastic hyperplasia, which can accompany herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis adjacent to necrotic foci.

ddx.vs: AITL has arborizing HEVs with clear T-follicular helper cells, expanded CD21+ dendritic networks, and aberrant PD1/CD10 expression with clonal TCR.
CHL contains Reed-Sternberg cells that are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5-weak in a mixed background, rather than a spectrum of polytypic immunoblasts.
EBV-driven immunoblastic proliferation is EBER positive and lacks HSV-positive infected cells.

1022.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片白血球極多、幾乎佔滿視野，可見從骨髓球、中骨髓球、後骨髓球到帶狀與分葉中性球的完整成熟階段，並有嗜鹼性球，呈「骨髓在血液中」的樣貌，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）的高白血球。
features: Marked leukocytosis with white cells crowding the field
Full spectrum of granulocytic maturation: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Myelocytes predominate among immature forms (myelocyte bulge); blasts not increased in this field
Scattered basophils with dark granules
Occasional nucleated red cells; red cells compressed between leukocytes
1022.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic population spanning myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with a prominence of myelocytes. Basophils are present, and blasts are not increased in this field. Granulocytes lack significant dysplasia or toxic change. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia with hyperleukocytosis; confirmation of BCR::ABL1 by FISH or RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Leukemoid reactions show toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with a metamyelocyte/band predominance, no basophilia, and lack BCR::ABL1.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia with little basophilia and lacks BCR::ABL1.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils with less than 10% immature granulocytes and harbors CSF3R mutation.

4158.recognize_zh: 幾乎所有腫瘤細胞核都呈強弱不一的棕色核染色，細胞中型、核形不規則；標記未標示，可能是 cyclin D1（套細胞淋巴瘤的核心標記）或 Ki-67（此高比例代表 blastoid/pleomorphic 型的高增生），兩者意義不同需確認。
features: Diffuse sheets of medium-sized lymphoid cells
Nuclear brown staining in nearly all tumor cells, with variable intensity
Irregular, angulated to oval nuclear contours
Coarsely granular nuclear staining pattern
Rare negative (blue) cells serving as internal control
4158.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (DAB; marker not specified) shows nuclear positivity in nearly all cells of a diffuse proliferation of medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours, with variable staining intensity and rare negative background cells. If this is cyclin D1, diffuse nuclear expression in a CD5+ B-cell lymphoma is consistent with mantle cell lymphoma. If this is Ki-67, a proliferation index approaching 90% or more would indicate a highly proliferative (blastoid or pleomorphic) variant with an adverse prognosis. The marker should be confirmed before interpretation.

ddx.vs: Cyclin D1-negative MCL expresses SOX11 and often has CCND2 rearrangement despite absent cyclin D1.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with t(11;14) or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These can express cyclin D1 but are CD138+ plasma cells or CD103+/annexin A1+ hairy cells, respectively.

ddx.dx: Burkitt lymphoma / high-grade B-cell lymphoma (if Ki-67)
ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma has ~100% Ki-67 with a starry-sky pattern, is CD10+ and MYC-rearranged, and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive with fine chromatin and lack cyclin D1.

4158.stain: IHC: nuclear marker not specified (cyclin D1 or Ki-67), DAB

3966.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的紅血球內血紅素濃縮成邊緣平直、有稜角的深色結晶塊，周圍留下淡染的空殼，形狀像手套或指狀突起，這就是 HbSC 結晶；背景還有許多靶形紅血球（target cells）。
features: Red cells with dense, straight-edged, angular hemoglobin crystals protruding from the cell (arrows)
Crystals leave pale, hemoglobin-poor cytoplasm in the rest of the cell; one has a glove/finger-like shape
Numerous target cells and folded cells in the background
No classic thin sickle cells in this field; platelets adequate
3966.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered red cells containing dense, straight-edged, angular hemoglobin crystals that bulge from the cell outline, leaving the remaining cytoplasm pale (arrows); one crystal-containing cell has a glove-like shape. The background shows numerous target cells and folded forms, while classic elongated sickle cells are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin SC disease; hemoglobin HPLC or electrophoresis should confirm HbS and HbC.

ddx.vs: HbC crystals in HbCC are hexagonal or rod-shaped with parallel sides, with many target cells and spherocytes, and without finger-like SC crystal projections.
HbSS shows many thin, crescent sickle cells with pointed ends rather than blunt, angular crystals.

ddx.dx: Irregularly contracted cells or fragmented red cells
ddx.vs: Contracted cells and schistocytes are uniformly dense throughout without a crystal inside a pale ghost of residual membrane.

3838.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加，有三系造血、數個巨核細胞、少量褐色含鐵血黃素與局部纖維束；此倍率無法辨識漿細胞增多，需高倍或 CD138 染色確認。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with little residual fat
Trilineage hematopoiesis with numerous scattered megakaryocytes
Focal streaming fibrous/stromal bands at left
Scattered golden-brown hemosiderin deposits
Plasma cells not individually assessable at this magnification
3838.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, numerous dispersed megakaryocytes, and focal streaming stromal bands. Scattered hemosiderin deposits are present. Plasma cells cannot be reliably identified or quantified at this magnification. The overall picture is that of a hypercellular reactive marrow, which in the HIV setting commonly accompanies polyclonal plasmacytosis; higher-power evaluation with CD138 and kappa/lambda stains is required.

ddx.vs: MPNs show clustered, atypical megakaryocytes and increased reticulin with driver mutations, which are not evident in this dispersed pattern.
MDS requires morphologic dysplasia on aspirate and/or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, which cannot be assessed at this power.
Myeloma would show interstitial clusters or sheets of monotypic plasma cells on higher power and immunostains.

3774.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中大量小型淋巴球呈棕色膜狀陽性，而散在其間的大型細胞（核大、淡染、有核仁）完全不著色，呈現「陰性大細胞浮在陽性小細胞海中」的格局；推測為 T 細胞標記（如 CD3），符合 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（THRLBCL）。
features: Diffuse sheet of small lymphocytes with strong membranous brown staining (T-cell marker pattern)
Scattered large cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli that are unstained
Large negative cells are singly dispersed, not clustered in sheets
Pale histiocyte-like cells with abundant cytoplasm also unstained
No nodular or follicular architecture seen in this field
3774.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node (antigen not labeled; pattern compatible with a pan-T-cell marker such as CD3) shows a diffuse background of small lymphocytes with strong membranous positivity. Interspersed singly are scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli that are negative, together with unstained histiocytes. The large cells do not form sheets or aggregates. In the context of large B-cell marker positivity in the large cells, findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL retains at least partly nodular architecture with residual follicular dendritic cell meshworks and small B-cell-rich nodules, whereas THRLBCL has a T-cell/histiocyte background devoid of small B cells.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and absent CD20/CD45, while THRLBCL large cells are CD20+, CD45+ and CD30/CD15 negative.
In PTCL the large atypical cells themselves express T-cell markers (often with antigen loss) and show clonal TCR rearrangement, instead of being T-marker negative B cells.

3582.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，在細胞豐富的骨髓內可見多處棕色陽性、紡錘形細胞的緻密聚集，部分靠近骨小樑，其餘散在；多灶性、緻密的陽性紡錘形肥大細胞聚集是系統性肥大細胞症的主要診斷準則。
features: Multifocal compact aggregates of brown immunopositive spindle-shaped cells
Aggregates located near a bony trabecula (paratrabecular) and in the interstitium
Scattered individual positive cells between adipocytes
Background cellular marrow with negative hematopoietic cells
Antigen not labeled; pattern fits a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117
3582.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a cellular marrow with multifocal compact aggregates of strongly staining, spindle-shaped cells in paratrabecular and interstitial locations, along with scattered single positive cells. Background hematopoietic cells are negative. The antigen is not labeled, but the distribution and spindle morphology are typical of a mast cell marker such as tryptase or CD117. Findings are consistent with multifocal dense mast cell infiltrates of systemic mastocytosis; CD25 expression, KIT D816V mutation, and serum tryptase level help confirm and classify the disease as indolent or advanced.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are round, scattered singly, and CD25-negative without compact aggregates of 15 or more cells.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with an associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: Similar mast cell aggregates but with a concurrent myeloid neoplasm evident on H&E, CD34, and blood counts.
Histiocytes and monocytes are CD68/CD163-positive but tryptase-negative.
Mast cells are round, well granulated, and often CD25-negative and KIT D816V-negative rather than spindle-shaped.

3646.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見多顆細胞核偏於一側、細胞質深藍且有核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof）的成熟漿細胞，散在於正常造血細胞之間，比例看起來偏高，符合漿細胞增多。
features: Increased scattered mature-appearing plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear clear zone (hof)
Clock-face (coarsely clumped) chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Plasma cells are interspersed singly rather than forming sheets
Background trilineage hematopoiesis with lymphocytes, granulocytes and erythroid precursors
3646.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows trilineage hematopoiesis with numerous lymphocytes and an increased number of scattered plasma cells. The plasma cells are mature-appearing, with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, and occur singly without sheets or significant nuclear atypia. Findings are consistent with plasmacytosis; a differential count, CD138 immunostaining with kappa/lambda light chain assessment and serum protein studies are needed to distinguish reactive plasmacytosis from a plasma cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Usually shows clonal plasma cells ≥10% often in clusters or sheets with atypia (binucleation, nucleoli, immature forms), confirmed by light chain restriction, whereas reactive plasmacytosis is polytypic and interstitial.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with increased mast cells and an IgM paraprotein/MYD88 L265P mutation.
Small lymphoid cells have scant cytoplasm and central nuclei without the eccentric nucleus and perinuclear hof of plasma cells.

3710.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中紅血球大小與正常小淋巴球核相近、中央淡染區約佔三分之一，顏色與形狀大致一致，細胞排列稀疏，沒有明顯小球性、低色素或碎片紅血球，符合正色素正球性貧血。
features: Red cells normocytic (similar in size to a small lymphocyte nucleus) with normal central pallor
Normochromic staining with only mild anisocytosis and occasional oval forms
Red cells relatively widely spaced in the monolayer, compatible with reduced red cell mass
No spherocytes, schistocytes, target cells, teardrop cells or polychromasia
Normal segmented neutrophils and scattered normal-sized platelets
3710.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with normal central pallor and only mild anisocytosis, without significant poikilocytosis or polychromasia. Red cells appear somewhat sparse in the monolayer, though red cell density on a smear is an imperfect estimate and the CBC is required to confirm anemia. The neutrophils and platelets are morphologically unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normochromic normocytic anemia; the differential includes anemia of chronic disease or inflammation, renal disease, early iron deficiency, acute blood loss and marrow infiltration or failure, and reticulocyte count and iron studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Progresses to hypochromic microcytic cells with enlarged central pallor, pencil cells and increased RDW, with low ferritin.
Typically shows polychromasia and specific poikilocytes such as spherocytes or schistocytes, which are absent here.
Shows a leukoerythroblastic picture with teardrop cells and circulating nucleated red cells and immature granulocytes, not seen in this field.

3198.recognize_zh: 中倍免疫染色下，竇內成群的大型棕色陽性組織球細胞質中，清楚可見多顆藍色未染的淋巴球被包在裡面，染色把 emperipolesis 凸顯出來，符合 Rosai-Dorfman 病（標記名稱未標示，推測為 S100）。
features: Clusters of large strongly positive histiocytes within sinuses
Numerous unstained (blue) intact lymphocytes enclosed within the positive cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Some positive cells show dark nuclear as well as cytoplasmic staining
Surrounding small lymphocytes negative
Antibody not specified; pattern compatible with S100
3198.describe_en: Medium-power immunohistochemical stain shows clusters of large positive histiocytes within lymph node sinuses. Many of these cells contain multiple unstained intact lymphocytes within their cytoplasm, highlighting emperipolesis against the brown cytoplasmic background, while the surrounding small lymphocytes are negative. The antibody is not specified; nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity in these histiocytes is compatible with S100. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are S100 positive but CD1a/langerin positive, smaller with grooved nuclei and do not show engulfed intact lymphocytes.
In hemophagocytosis the ingested cells (often red cells and nucleated cells) are degraded within phagolysosomes and the macrophages are S100 negative.
Melanoma cells are S100 positive but show cytologic atypia, SOX10/melan-A positivity and lack emperipolesis.

3326.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，造血細胞間可見許多核圓或橢圓、染色質開放、帶小核仁且細胞質淡染的單核細胞呈間質性散佈，混合巨核細胞與嗜酸性前驅細胞；單憑 H&E 難與正常造血分辨，需免疫染色證實毛細胞白血病變異型浸潤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with preserved megakaryocytes and scattered eosinophilic precursors
Interstitial population of mononuclear cells with round-to-oval nuclei and moderately open chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli in some mononuclear cells
Moderate pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm without the widely spaced fried-egg pattern of classic HCL
Intervening extravasated red cells; no reticulin assessment possible on H&E
3326.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with preserved megakaryocytes and eosinophilic precursors. Interspersed interstitially among hematopoietic elements is a population of mononuclear cells with round-to-oval nuclei, moderately open chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm. The infiltrate is subtle and lacks the widely spaced fried-egg appearance of classic hairy cell leukemia, so its extent cannot be accurately estimated on H&E alone. Findings are compatible with interstitial involvement by hairy cell leukemia variant; CD20, CD79a/PAX5 and annexin A1 immunostains are recommended to highlight and characterize the infiltrate.

ddx.vs: Classic HCL shows a fried-egg interstitial infiltrate with reticulin fibrosis and is annexin A1, CD25 and BRAF V600E positive.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma in marrow
ddx.vs: SMZL typically shows intrasinusoidal and nodular paratrabecular aggregates of small cells without nucleoli.
A reactive marrow lacks a clonal CD20-positive interstitial population on immunohistochemistry.
Mast cell infiltrates form spindle-cell aggregates with fibrosis and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.

3006.recognize_zh: 表皮內一團聚集的非典型淋巴球，核深染、形狀扭曲如腦回（cerebriform），周圍是核較淡、有核仁的角質細胞，這種表皮內淋巴球聚集就是 Pautrier 微膿瘍，是蕈狀肉芽腫的特徵。
features: Intraepidermal aggregate of lymphocytes within the stratum spinosum
Lymphocytes with hyperchromatic, irregular to convoluted (cerebriform) nuclei
Scant cytoplasm; some cells surrounded by clear perinuclear halos
Surrounding keratinocytes with larger pale oval nuclei and small nucleoli
Minimal spongiosis accompanying the lymphoid aggregate
3006.describe_en: High-power view of the epidermis shows a discrete intraepidermal collection of lymphocytes among spinous keratinocytes. The lymphocytes have hyperchromatic, irregular to convoluted nuclei with scant cytoplasm, and several sit within clear halos, while spongiosis is minimal. The adjacent keratinocytes have larger pale nuclei with small nucleoli. Findings represent a Pautrier microabscess and are consistent with mycosis fungoides.

ddx.dx: Spongiotic dermatitis with Langerhans cell microvesicles
ddx.vs: Spongiotic vesicles contain Langerhans cells with pale, reniform nuclei and abundant cytoplasm within prominent spongiosis, not dark cerebriform lymphocytes without spongiosis.
Pagetoid reticulosis shows striking pagetoid spread of larger atypical cells throughout the epidermis in a solitary acral plaque, often CD8+ or CD4-CD8-.
ATLL can form Pautrier-like collections but is HTLV-1 positive with CD25 expression and flower cells in blood.

2942.recognize_zh: 同一視野中有核摺疊、細胞質灰藍帶細顆粒的單核球系細胞，加上原始細胞，以及含橘紅與暗紫色顆粒的嗜酸性前驅細胞，組合起來提示伴嗜酸性球增多的急性骨髓單核球性白血病（AML M4Eo）。
features: Monocytic cells (promonocytes/monocytes) with folded, reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Two blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Eosinophil precursor with orange granules and an immature eosinophil with dark purple (basophilic-appearing) granules
Mixed myelomonocytic population clustered on a background of normocytic red cells
2942.describe_en: The smear shows a cluster of immature myelomonocytic cells. Several cells have folded, indented nuclei with delicate chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules, consistent with promonocytes and monocytes, admixed with blasts showing fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm. Eosinophil precursors are present, including one with dark purple-violet granules suggestive of abnormal eosinophils. In the setting of prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are suggestive of therapy-related acute myelomonocytic leukemia with eosinophilia (M4Eo morphology); confirmation of CBFB::MYH11 or inv(16) is recommended.

ddx.vs: M5 lacks the increased eosinophil lineage with abnormal dark granules and shows ≥80% monocytic-lineage cells without a significant granulocytic component.
CMML has <20% blasts/promonocytes with mature monocytosis, whereas this picture is dominated by blasts and promonocytes.
These show mature eosinophilia without a blast/promonocyte excess and are distinguished by FISH/RT-PCR rather than inv(16).

2814.recognize_zh: 左移的顆粒球系細胞中，有一顆被黑紫色粗顆粒完全遮住核的嗜鹼性球，旁邊另有一顆顆粒較少的嗜鹼性球，加上骨髓細胞、帶狀與分葉核中性球；嗜鹼性球增加是 CML 加速期的線索。
features: Basophil with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Second basophil with fewer, discrete coarse dark granules over a lobulated nucleus
Myelocytes and promyelocytes with round nuclei and gray granular cytoplasm
Bands, metamyelocytes and segmented neutrophils (left-shifted maturation)
Scattered red cells with a sparse background, suggesting a buffy coat or thin area
2814.describe_en: The smear shows left-shifted granulocytic cells including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Two basophils are present, one densely granulated with granules obscuring the nucleus and one with fewer coarse granules. Obvious blasts are not identified in this field, and neutrophil dysplasia is not evident. Basophilia of >=20% in peripheral blood, together with the clinical context of BCR::ABL1-positive CML, supports accelerated phase; the percentage must be established by a differential count.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase commonly shows basophilia below 20%; the quantitative threshold, not morphology, separates the phases.
Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus and densely packed metachromatic granules, and are tryptase/CD117-positive, whereas basophils have a lobulated nucleus and water-soluble granules.
Toxic granules are fine and evenly distributed in neutrophils, while basophil granules are coarse, dark and overlie the nucleus.
Acute basophilic leukemia shows >=20% blasts with sparse coarse basophilic granules rather than a maturing granulocytic background.

2430.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血細胞只剩淡粉紅色的「鬼影」輪廓，核不染色或僅殘留模糊核影，背景為無結構的嗜酸性顆粒狀壞死物，脂肪空泡輪廓仍在，這是骨髓壞死（bone marrow necrosis）的典型表現。
features: Loss of nuclear staining in hematopoietic cells, leaving pale eosinophilic ghost cell outlines
Only faint, smudged residual nuclear outlines; no crisp basophilic chromatin
Amorphous, granular eosinophilic background replacing normal marrow architecture
Preserved fat vacuole outlines scattered through the necrotic tissue
No viable hematopoietic elements or inflammatory infiltrate evident in this field
2430.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows marrow spaces replaced by pale eosinophilic, amorphous granular material. Cellular outlines are still discernible as ghost cells, but nuclear staining is lost or reduced to faint smudges, and no viable hematopoietic cells are identified in this field. Adipocyte vacuoles remain as empty spaces. There is no evident fibrosis or inflammatory reaction. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis; evaluation of viable areas for an underlying cause (e.g., acute leukemia, metastatic tumor, sickle cell disease, infection) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation shows pale extracellular mucoid material with fat atrophy and hypocellularity but lacks ghost cell outlines of dead cells.

ddx.dx: Poorly fixed or crushed marrow biopsy
ddx.vs: Fixation/crush artifact produces smeared, streaming basophilic nuclei rather than uniformly anucleate eosinophilic ghost cells.
Therapy-related aplasia shows empty stroma with fat, edema and hemorrhage, not sheets of necrotic ghost cells.

2302.recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞具有豐富淡灰藍色、細顆粒的細胞質，核卵圓或有摺疊、染色質細緻；箭頭指向細胞間大片灰色顆粒狀細胞質，這是單核球系的特徵。
features: Cluster of large cells with abundant pale gray-blue, finely granular cytoplasm (arrow)
Oval, indented or folded nuclei with fine lacy chromatin
Some nuclei with small nucleoli; variable N:C ratio
Irregular cytoplasmic borders with pseudopod-like extensions
Background of red cells; no Auer rods
2302.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large cells with abundant pale gray-blue, finely granular cytoplasm and irregular borders; the arrow highlights this abundant monocytoid cytoplasm. Nuclei are oval to indented or folded with fine lacy chromatin and occasional small nucleoli. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with acute monocytic leukemia composed of monoblasts and promonocytes.

ddx.vs: AMML shows at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells and MPO-positive myeloblasts in addition to monocytic cells.
CMML monocytes are more mature with condensed chromatin, and blasts plus promonocytes remain below 20%.
Macrophages have abundant cytoplasm with phagocytosed material and more condensed nuclei, and histiocytic sarcoma is a tissue-based tumor rather than a circulating blast population.

2110.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球胞質布滿深紫色粗大毒性顆粒，右下方胞質邊緣有一小塊淡藍灰色、無顆粒的區域（Döhle body），核分葉且染色質粗糙，是毒性顆粒合併 Döhle body 的清楚例子。
features: Neutrophil with heavy coarse dark purple toxic granulation
Pale blue-gray agranular patch at lower-right cytoplasmic periphery (Döhle body)
Segmented nucleus with coarse clumped chromatin
Surrounding red cells with rouleaux-like stacking and scattered drying artifact
Occasional small platelets in background
2110.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a segmented neutrophil with heavy coarse dark purple toxic granulation and a pale blue-gray agranular patch at the lower-right cytoplasmic periphery, representing a Döhle body. Surrounding red cells show some stacking and drying artifact. Findings are consistent with toxic changes of neutrophils, as seen with severe infection, sepsis, or G-CSF administration.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are present in all leukocyte lineages and are not accompanied by Döhle bodies.
